ko.title: 10월 15일 세금 연장 마감일: 마감 전 신고자가 해야 할 일

segments.src: If you requested more time to file your federal income tax return back in April, your extended deadline arrives this week: **Thursday, October 15**.
segments.tr: 만약 4월에 연방 소득세 신고 기한 연장을 요청했다면, 연장된 마감일이 이번 주에 다가옵니다: **목요일, 10월 15일**.

segments.src: For millions of Americans, this is the last scheduled day to submit a 2025 return without running into additional late-filing consequences.
segments.tr: 수백만 명의 미국인에게 이는 추가적인 지연 신고 결과에 직면하지 않고 2025년 세금 신고서를 제출할 수 있는 마지막 예정일입니다.

segments.src: Here is a plain-language guide to who is affected, what the extension actually covers, and how to limit penalties and interest.
segments.tr: 다음은 영향받는 사람, 연장이 실제로 다루는 범위, 그리고 벌금과이자를 제한하는 방법에 대한 평이한 언어 가이드입니다.

segments.src: ## Who is affected
segments.tr: ## 누가 영향을 받나요

segments.src: The October 15 date applies to taxpayers who filed Form 4868 (for individuals) or otherwise requested an automatic six-month extension by the April deadline.
segments.tr: 10월 15일은 (개인용) 양식 4868을 제출했거나 4월 마감일까지 자동 6개월 연장을 요청한 납세자에게 적용됩니다.

segments.src: That group typically includes:
segments.tr: 해당 그룹에는 일반적으로 다음이 포함됩니다:

segments.src: - **Self-employed workers and freelancers** with complex income and estimated payments to reconcile
segments.tr: - **자영업자 및 프리랜서**: 복잡한 소득과 정산해야 할 추정 납부액이 있는 경우

segments.src: - **Small business owners and investors** waiting on partnership, S corporation, or brokerage documents
segments.tr: - **소상공인 및 투자자**: 파트너십, S 코퍼레이션 또는 브로커리지 문서를 기다리는 경우

segments.src: - **Households with several income sources**, such as rental income, stock sales, or retirement distributions
segments.tr: - **여러 소득원을 가진 가구**: 임대 소득, 주식 매각 또는 은퇴 분배금 등이 있는 경우

segments.src: - **People who simply ran out of time** or were missing key forms in the spring
segments.tr: - **시간이 부족했거나** 봄에 주요 양식이 누락되었던 사람들

segments.src: If you did not request an extension and have not yet filed, you are already past the original due date, and late-filing and late-payment rules may already be applying to you.
segments.tr: 연장을 요청하지 않았고 아직 신고하지 않았다면 이미 원래 납부 기한이 지난 것이며, 지연 신고 및 지연 납부 규정이 이미 적용되고 있을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Filing as soon as possible is still better than waiting.
segments.tr: 기다리는 것보다 가능한 빨리 신고하는 것이 여전히 좋습니다.

segments.src: ## An extension to file is not an extension to pay
segments.tr: ## 신고 연장은 납부 연장이 아닙니다

segments.src: This is the most common point of confusion.
segments.tr: 이것이 가장 흔한 혼동 지점입니다.

segments.src: An extension gives you more time to **submit your paperwork**.
segments.tr: 연장은 **서류 제출**을 위한 더 많은 시간을 제공합니다.

segments.src: It does not give you more time to **pay what you owe**.
segments.tr: 이는 **납부해야 할 금액을 지불할** 더 많은 시간을 주지 않습니다.

segments.src: Taxes for 2025 were due in April, and any unpaid balance has been accruing charges since then.
segments.tr: 2025년 세금은 4월에 납부해야 했으며, 미납된 잔액은 그 이후로 비용이 누적되고 있습니다.

segments.src: That means two separate costs may already be running on a balance due:
segments.tr: 즉, 미납 잔액에 대해 이미 두 가지 별도의 비용이 발생하고 있을 수 있습니다:

segments.src: 1. **Interest.** The IRS charges interest on unpaid tax from the original due date until the balance is paid in full. The rate is based on the federal short-term rate plus three percentage points and is reset each quarter. Interest compounds daily.
segments.tr: 1. **이자.** IRS는 원래 납부 기한부터 잔액이 전액 납부될 때까지 미납 세금에 대해 이자를 부과합니다. 이율은 연방 단기 금리에 3%를 더한 값을 기준으로 하며 매분기 재설정됩니다. 이자는 복리로 매일 계산됩니다.

segments.src: 2. **Failure-to-pay penalty.** This is generally 0.5% of the unpaid tax for each month or partial month the balance remains unpaid, up to a maximum of 25%.
segments.tr: 2. **미납 벌금.** 이는 일반적으로 잔액이 미납된 상태로 유지되는 매월 또는 부분 월마다 미납 세금의 0.5이며, 최대 25%까지 부과됩니다.

segments.src: ## What happens if you miss October 15
segments.tr: ## 10월 15일을 놓치면 어떻게 되나요

segments.src: Missing the extended deadline adds a third cost on top of the two above:
segments.tr: 연장된 마감일을 놓치면 위의 두 가지 비용 외에 세 번째 비용이 추가됩니다:

segments.src: - **Failure-to-file penalty.** This is generally 5% of the unpaid tax for each month or partial month the return is late, up to 25%. When both the late-filing and late-payment penalties apply in the same month, the combined rate is typically 5% for that month, because the filing penalty is reduced by the payment penalty.
segments.tr: - **미신고 벌금.** 이는 신고서가 지연된 매월 또는 부분 월마다 미납 세금의 5이며, 최대 25%까지 부과됩니다. 동일한 달에 지연 신고와 지연 납부 벌금이 모두 적용되는 경우, 신고 벌금이 납부 벌금만큼 차감되므로 해당 월의 결합된 요율은 일반적으로 5입니다.

segments.src: - **Minimum penalty.** If a return is more than 60 days late, a minimum penalty applies, which is the lesser of a set dollar amount (adjusted for inflation) or 100% of the tax owed.
segments.tr: - **최소 벌금.** 신고서가 60일 이상 늦어진 경우 최소 벌금이 부과되며, 이는 정해진 금액(인플레이션 반영) 또는 세금 전액 중 적은 금액입니다.

segments.src: Because the filing penalty is ten times larger than the payment penalty each month, **filing on time matters even if you cannot pay everything you owe.**
segments.tr: 신고 벌금이 납부 벌금보다 매월 10배 크기 때문에, **모든 세금을 납부할 수 없더라도 제때 신고하는 것이 중요합니다.**

segments.src: ## What to do now
segments.tr: ## 지금 해야 할 일

segments.src: Gather your documents.** Collect W-2s, 1099s, brokerage statements, business records, and any corrected forms.
segments.tr: 문서를 수집하세요.** W-2, 1099, 브로커리지 명세서, 사업 기록 및 수정된 양식을 수집하십시오.

segments.src: If something is still missing, you can request a copy from the issuer or obtain your income transcript through your IRS online account.
segments.tr: 여전히 누락된 것이 있다면 발행인에게 사본을 요청하거나 IRS 온라인 계정을 통해 소득 성적증명서를 발급받을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Estimate what you owe.** Even a reasonable estimate helps you decide how much to send with your return.
segments.tr: 납부할 금액을 추산하세요.** 합리적인 추정치라도 신고서와 함께 얼마나 보낼지 결정하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

segments.src: Overpaying slightly is generally better than underpaying, since a refund can be issued later.
segments.tr: 나중에 환급금을 받을 수 있으므로 과소납부하는 것보다 약간 과다납부하는 것이 일반적으로 좋습니다.

segments.src: File by the deadline.** Electronic filing is the fastest route, and e-filed returns are typically acknowledged within a day or two.
segments.tr: 마감일까지 신고하세요.** 전자 신고가 가장 빠른 경로이며, 전자 신고된 신고서는 일반적으로 하루 이내에 접수됩니다.

segments.src: If you are using tax software or a preparer, confirm they can submit before the cutoff, since many offices are busy this week.
segments.tr: 세무 소프트웨어나 세무 대리인을 사용하는 경우 이번 주에 많은 사무실이 바쁘므로 마감일 전에 제출할 수 있는지 확인하십시오.

segments.src: Pay what you can.** Payment options include IRS Direct Pay from a bank account, a debit or credit card (processing fees apply), or the Electronic Federal Tax Payment System.
segments.tr: 낼 수 있는 만큼 납부하세요.** 납부 옵션에는 은행 계좌에서 IRS 직접 납부, 직불 또는 신용카드(수수료 부과), 또는 전자 연방 세금 납부 시스템이 포함됩니다.

segments.src: Paying part of the balance reduces the amount on which penalties and interest are calculated.
segments.tr: 잔액의 일부를 납부하면 벌금과 이자가 계산되는 금액이 줄어듭니다.

segments.src: If you cannot pay in full, ask about a payment plan.** The IRS offers short-term payment arrangements and longer-term installment agreements.
segments.tr: 전액을 납부할 수 없는 경우, 납부 계획에 대해 문의하세요.** IRS는 단기 납부 약정과 장기 할부 계약을 제공합니다.

segments.src: Many individuals can apply online.
segments.tr: 많은 개인이 온라인으로 신청할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Penalties and interest continue to accrue on an unpaid balance during a plan, but the failure-to-pay rate is generally reduced while an approved installment agreement is in effect.
segments.tr: 계획 기간 동안 미납 잔액에 대해 벌금과 이자가 계속 누적되지만, 승인된 할부 계약이 유효한 동안에는 미납 요율이 일반적으로 감소합니다.

segments.src: ## Special situations
segments.tr: ## 특별 상황

segments.src: - **Expecting a refund?** There is generally no failure-to-file penalty when you are owed a refund. However, you usually have three years from the original due date to claim it, so it is still worth filing.
segments.tr: - **환급을 기대하시나요?** 환급을 받아야 할 때는 일반적으로 미신고 벌금이 없습니다. 그러나 보통 원래 납부 기한부터 3년 이내에 청구해야 하므로 여전히 신고할 가치가 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Living abroad?** U.S. citizens and residents living outside the country receive an automatic extension to June 15 and can request additional time, which may run to December 15.
segments.tr: - **해외 거주 중이신가요?** 해외에 거주하는 미국 시민과 거주자는 6월 15일까지 자동 연장을 받으며 12월 15일까지 연장될 수 있는 추가 시간을 요청할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Affected by a federally declared disaster?** The IRS often postpones deadlines for affected areas. Check the agency's disaster relief page to see whether your county qualifies and what your specific date is.
segments.tr: - **연방 재난 선포 지역에 해당하시나요?** IRS는 종종 피해 지역의 마감일을 연기합니다. 귀하의 카운티가 자격이 되는지, 구체적인 날짜가 언제인지 확인하려면 기관의 재난 구호 페이지를 확인하십시오.

segments.src: - **Penalty relief.** If you have a reasonable explanation for filing or paying late, or a clean compliance history, you may qualify for penalty abatement. The IRS has an administrative waiver for first-time offenders who meet certain conditions.
segments.tr: - **벌금 면제.** 지연 신고 또는 납부에 대한 합리적인 설명이 있거나 깨끗한 준수 이력이 있는 경우, 벌금 면제 자격이 될 수 있습니다. IRS에는 특정 조건을 충족하는 최초 위반자에 대한 행정적 면제가 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Common mistakes to avoid
segments.tr: ## 피해야 할 흔한 실수

segments.src: - **Assuming the extension covered payment.** It did not.
segments.tr: - **연장이 납부를 포함한다고 가정하기.** 그렇지 않습니다.

segments.src: - **Waiting for a perfect return.** Filing an accurate return on time is better than a late one with every detail polished. You can file an amended return later if needed.
segments.tr: - **완벽한 신고서를 기다리기.** 모든 세부 사항이 다듬어진 늦은 신고서보다 제때 정확한 신고서를 제출하는 것이 좋습니다. 필요한 경우 나중에 수정 신고서를 제출할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Skipping the signature or identity step.** E-filers may need a prior-year adjusted gross income figure or an identity PIN. Have these ready.
segments.tr: - **서명 또는 신원 확인 단계 건너뛰기.** 전자 신고자는 전년도 수정 총소득 수치나 신원 PIN이 필요할 수 있습니다. 이를 준비해 두세요.

segments.src: - **Ignoring IRS notices.** If you receive a letter, read it carefully and respond by the stated date.
segments.tr: - **IRS 통지서 무시하기.** 편지를 받으면 주의 깊게 읽고 명시된 날짜까지 응답하세요.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 요약

segments.src: October 15 is a firm date for extension filers.
segments.tr: 10월 15일은 연장 신고자에게 확정된 날짜입니다.

segments.src: Submit your return on time, pay as much as you can, and contact the IRS about a payment arrangement if you cannot cover the full amount.
segments.tr: 제때 신고서를 제출하고, 가능한 많이 납부하며, 전액을 충당할 수 없는 경우 IRS에 납부 일정에 대해 문의하세요.

segments.src: Taking those steps will help keep penalties and interest as low as possible.
segments.tr: 이러한 단계를 밟으면 벌금과 이자를 최대한 낮게 유지하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not tax advice.
segments.tr: *이 글은 일반적인 정보 제공용이며 세무 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Rules and amounts can change, and individual circumstances vary.
segments.tr: 규칙과 금액은 변경될 수 있으며 개인의 상황은 다릅니다.

segments.src: Consult a qualified tax professional or visit IRS.gov for guidance specific to your situation.*
segments.tr: 귀하의 상황에 맞는 지침을 위해 자격을 갖춘 세무 전문가와 상담하거나 IRS.gov를 방문하십시오.*

segments.src: That group typically includes:

segments.tr: 它并没有给你更多时间来**支付你欠的税款**。

segments.src: ## What happens if you miss October 15
segments.tr: ## 如果错过10月15日会发生什么

segments.src: Missing the extended deadline adds a third cost on top of the two above:
segments.tr: 错过延期截止日期会在上述两项费用的基础上增加第三项费用：

segments.src: - **Failure-to-file penalty.** This is generally 5% of the unpaid tax for each month or partial month the return is late, up to 25%. When both the late-filing and late-payment penalties apply in the same month, the combined rate is typically 5% for that month, because the filing penalty is reduced by the payment penalty.
segments.tr: - **未申报罚款。** 对于税表迟交的每个月或部分月份，这通常是未付税款的5%，最高可达25%。当逾期申报和逾期付款罚款在同一个月适用时，组合利率通常为该月的5%，因为申报罚款会按付款罚款相应减少。

segments.src: - **Minimum penalty.** If a return is more than 60 days late, a minimum penalty applies, which is the lesser of a set dollar amount (adjusted for inflation) or 100% of the tax owed.
segments.tr: - **最低罚款。** 如果税表迟交超过60天，则适用最低罚款，即设定的固定金额（根据通货膨胀调整）或所欠税款的100%中的较小者。

segments.src: Because the filing penalty is ten times larger than the payment penalty each month, **filing on time matters even if you cannot pay everything you owe.**
segments.tr: 由于每个月的申报罚款是付款罚款的十倍，因此**即使你无法支付所欠的全额，按时报税也很重要。**

segments.src: ## What to do now
segments.tr: ## 现在该做什么

segments.src: Gather your documents.** Collect W-2s, 1099s, brokerage statements, business records, and any corrected forms.
segments.tr: 收集你的文件。** 收集W-2、1099、经纪对账单、商业记录以及任何更正过的表格。

segments.src: If something is still missing, you can request a copy from the issuer or obtain your income transcript through your IRS online account.
segments.tr: 如果仍有东西缺失，你可以向发件方索取副本，或者通过你的IRS在线账户获取收入记录。

segments.src: Estimate what you owe.** Even a reasonable estimate helps you decide how much to send with your return.
segments.tr: 估算你欠多少税。** 即使是一个合理的估算也能帮你在报税时决定寄出多少钱。

segments.src: Overpaying slightly is generally better than underpaying, since a refund can be issued later.
segments.tr: 稍微多付通常比少付好，因为退款以后可以发放。

segments.src: File by the deadline.** Electronic filing is the fastest route, and e-filed returns are typically acknowledged within a day or two.
segments.tr: 在截止日期前报税。** 电子报税是最快的途径，电子报税的税表通常会在一两天内收到确认。

segments.src: If you are using tax software or a preparer, confirm they can submit before the cutoff, since many offices are busy this week.
segments.tr: 如果你正在使用税务软件或报税员，请确认他们可以在截止日期前提交，因为许多办公室本周都很忙。

segments.src: Pay what you can.** Payment options include IRS Direct Pay from a bank account, a debit or credit card (processing fees apply), or the Electronic Federal Tax Payment System.
segments.tr: 支付你能支付的部分。** 支付选项包括从银行账户中进行IRS Direct Pay、借记卡或信用卡（需支付处理费）或电子联邦税款支付系统。

segments.src: Paying part of the balance reduces the amount on which penalties and interest are calculated.
segments.tr: 支付部分余额会减少计算罚款和利息的基数。

segments.src: If you cannot pay in full, ask about a payment plan.** The IRS offers short-term payment arrangements and longer-term installment agreements.
segments.tr: 如果你无法全额支付，请询问分期付款计划。** IRS提供短期付款安排和长期分期协议。

segments.src: Many individuals can apply online.
segments.tr: 许多个人可以在线申请。

segments.src: Penalties and interest continue to accrue on an unpaid balance during a plan, but the failure-to-pay rate is generally reduced while an approved installment agreement is in effect.
segments.tr: 在计划执行期间，罚款和利息继续在未付余额上累积，但在批准的分期协议生效期间，未付罚款率通常会降低。

segments.src: ## Special situations
segments.tr: ## 特殊情况

segments.src: - **Expecting a refund?** There is generally no failure-to-file penalty when you are owed a refund. However, you usually have three years from the original due date to claim it, so it is still worth filing.
segments.tr: - **预计会收到退款？** 当你应得退款时，通常没有未申报罚款。但是，你通常有从原到期日起三年的时间来索取，所以报税仍然是值得的。

segments.src: - **Living abroad?** U.S. citizens and residents living outside the country receive an automatic extension to June 15 and can request additional time, which may run to December 15.
segments.tr: - **住在国外？** 居住在国外的美国公民和居民会自动延期至6月15日，并可以申请额外的时间，可能会延长至12月15日。

segments.src: - **Affected by a federally declared disaster?** The IRS often postpones deadlines for affected areas. Check the agency's disaster relief page to see whether your county qualifies and what your specific date is.
segments.tr: - **受联邦宣布的灾难影响？** IRS通常会推迟受影响地区的截止日期。请查看该机构的灾难救援页面，以了解您的县是否有资格以及您的具体日期是什么时候。

segments.src: - **Penalty relief.** If you have a reasonable explanation for filing or paying late, or a clean compliance history, you may qualify for penalty abatement. The IRS has an administrative waiver for first-time offenders who meet certain conditions.
segments.tr: - **罚款减免。** 如果你有延迟申报或付款的合理解释，或者有良好的合规记录，你可能有资格获得罚款减免。IRS为符合特定条件的第一犯者提供行政豁免。

segments.src: ## Common mistakes to avoid
segments.tr: ## 需要避免的常见错误

segments.src: - **Assuming the extension covered payment.** It did not.
segments.tr: - **假设延期包括了付款。** 并没有。

segments.src: - **Waiting for a perfect return.** Filing an accurate return on time is better than a late one with every detail polished. You can file an amended return later if needed.
segments.tr: - **等待一份完美的税表。** 按时提交准确的税表要好过每个细节都打磨完美的迟交税表。如果需要，你以后可以提交修改后的税表。

segments.src: - **Skipping the signature or identity step.** E-filers may need a prior-year adjusted gross income figure or an identity PIN. Have these ready.
segments.tr: - **跳过签名或身份验证步骤。** 电子报税人可能需要前一年的调整后总收入数字或身份PIN码。请准备好这些。

segments.src: - **Ignoring IRS notices.** If you receive a letter, read it carefully and respond by the stated date.
segments.tr: - **忽视IRS通知。** 如果你收到信件，请仔细阅读并在规定的日期前回复。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: October 15 is a firm date for extension filers.
segments.tr: 10月15日是延期报税人的硬性日期。

segments.src: Submit your return on time, pay as much as you can, and contact the IRS about a payment arrangement if you cannot cover the full amount.
segments.tr: 按时提交你的税表，尽你所能支付，如果你无法支付全额，请就付款安排联系IRS。

segments.src: Taking those steps will help keep penalties and interest as low as possible.
segments.tr: 采取这些步骤将有助于将罚款和利息保持在尽可能低的水平。

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not tax advice.
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般参考，并非税务建议。

segments.src: Rules and amounts can change, and individual circumstances vary.
segments.tr: 规则和金额可能会发生变化，个人情况各不相同。

segments.src: Consult a qualified tax professional or visit IRS.gov for guidance specific to your situation.*
segments.tr: 请咨询合格的税务专业人士或访问 IRS.以获取针对您具体情况的指导。*

hi.title: 15 अक्टूबर टैक्स एक्सटेंशन की समय सीमा: फाइल करने वालों को समय सीमा से पहले क्या करना चाहिए

segments.src: If you requested more time to file your federal income tax return back in April, your extended deadline arrives this week: **Thursday, October 15**.
segments.tr: यदि आपने अप्रैल में अपने संघीय आयकर रिटर्न को फाइल करने के लिए अधिक समय का अनुरोध किया था, तो आपकी विस्तारित समय सीमा इस सप्ताह आ रही है: **गुरुवार, 15 अक्टूबर**।

segments.src: For millions of Americans, this is the last scheduled day to submit a 2025 return without running into additional late-filing consequences.
segments.tr: लाखों अमेरिकियों के लिए, यह 2025 का रिटर्न जमा करने का अंतिम निर्धारित दिन है, ताकि देर से फाइल करने के अतिरिक्त परिणामों से बचा जा सके।

segments.src: Here is a plain-language guide to who is affected, what the extension actually covers, and how to limit penalties and interest.
segments.tr: यहाँ उन लोगों के लिए एक सरल भाषा में गाइड दी गई है जो प्रभावित हैं, एक्सटेंशन वास्तव में क्या कवर करता है, और दंड और ब्याज को कैसे सीमित किया जाए।

segments.src: ## Who is affected
segments.tr: ## कौन प्रभावित है

segments.src: The October 15 date applies to taxpayers who filed Form 4868 (for individuals) or otherwise requested an automatic six-month extension by the April deadline.
segments.tr: 15 अक्टूबर की तारीख उन करदाताओं पर लागू होती है जिन्होंने फॉर्म 4868 (व्यक्तियों के लिए) फाइल किया है या अन्यथा अप्रैल की समय सीमा तक छह महीने के स्वचालित एक्सटेंशन का अनुरोध किया है।

segments.src: That group typically includes:
segments.tr: उस समूह में आमतौर पर शामिल हैं:

segments.src: - **Self-employed workers and freelancers** with complex income and estimated payments to reconcile
segments.tr: - **स्व-रोजगार वाले कर्मचारी और फ्रीलांसर** जिनकी जटिल आय है और जिन्हें अनुमानित भुगतान का मिलान करना है

segments.src: - **Small business owners and investors** waiting on partnership, S corporation, or brokerage documents
segments.tr: - **छोटे व्यवसाय के मालिक और निवेशक** जो पार्टनरशिप, एस कॉर्पोरेशन, या ब्रोकरेज दस्तावेजों का इंतजार कर रहे हैं

segments.src: - **Households with several income sources**, such as rental income, stock sales, or retirement distributions
segments.tr: - **कई आय स्रोतों वाले परिवार**, जैसे कि किराये से आय, स्टॉक बिक्री, या सेवानिवृत्ति वितरण

segments.src: - **People who simply ran out of time** or were missing key forms in the spring
segments.tr: - **वे लोग जिनके पास बस समय खत्म हो गया था** या जिनके पास वसंत ऋतु में महत्वपूर्ण फॉर्म नहीं थे

segments.src: If you did not request an extension and have not yet filed, you are already past the original due date, and late-filing and late-payment rules may already be applying to you.
segments.tr: यदि आपने एक्सटेंशन का अनुरोध नहीं किया है और अभी तक फाइल नहीं किया है, तो आप पहले ही मूल देय तिथि पार कर चुके हैं, और देर से फाइल करने और देर से भुगतान करने के नियम आप पर पहले से ही लागू हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: Filing as soon as possible is still better than waiting.
segments.tr: इंतजार करने की तुलना में जल्द से जल्द फाइल करना अभी भी बेहतर है।

segments.src: ## An extension to file is not an extension to pay
segments.tr: ## फाइल करने का एक्सटेंशन भुगतान करने का एक्सटेंशन नहीं है

segments.src: This is the most common point of confusion.
segments.tr: यह भ्रम का सबसे आम बिंदु है।

segments.src: An extension gives you more time to **submit your paperwork**.
segments.tr: एक एक्सटेंशन आपको **अपने कागजी कार्रवाई जमा करने** के लिए अधिक समय देता है।

segments.src: It does not give you more time to **pay what you owe**.
segments.tr: यह आपको **जो आप पर बकाया है उसे चुकाने** के लिए अधिक समय नहीं देता है।

segments.src: Taxes for 2025 were due in April, and any unpaid balance has been accruing charges since then.
segments.tr: 2025 के लिए कर अप्रैल में देय थे, और तब से किसी भी अवैतनिक शेष राशि पर शुल्क लग रहा है।

segments.src: That means two separate costs may already be running on a balance due:
segments.tr: इसका मतलब है कि बकाया राशि पर पहले से ही दो अलग-अलग लागतें चल रही हो सकती हैं:

segments.src: 1. **Interest.** The IRS charges interest on unpaid tax from the original due date until the balance is paid in full. The rate is based on the federal short-term rate plus three percentage points and is reset each quarter. Interest compounds daily.
segments.tr: 1. **ब्याज।** IRS मूल देय तिथि से लेकर शेष राशि का पूरा भुगतान होने तक अवैतनिक कर पर ब्याज लेता है। दर संघीय अल्पकालिक दर प्लस तीन प्रतिशत अंकों पर आधारित है और हर तिमाही में रीसेट की जाती है। ब्याज दैनिक रूप से जुड़ता है।

segments.src: 2. **Failure-to-pay penalty.** This is generally 0.5% of the unpaid tax for each month or partial month the balance remains unpaid, up to a maximum of 25%.
segments.tr: 2. **भुगतान न करने का दंड।** यह आमतौर पर अवैतनिक कर का 0.5% होता है, प्रत्येक महीने या आंशिक महीने के लिए जब तक शेष राशि का भुगतान नहीं किया जाता है, अधिकतम 25% तक।

segments.src: ## What happens if you miss October 15
segments.tr: ## यदि आप 15 अक्टूबर चूक जाते हैं तो क्या होता है

segments.src: Missing the extended deadline adds a third cost on top of the two above:
segments.tr: विस्तारित समय सीमा चूकने से ऊपर दी गई दो लागतों के अलावा तीसरी लागत जुड़ जाती है:

segments.src: - **Failure-to-file penalty.** This is generally 5% of the unpaid tax for each month or partial month the return is late, up to 25%. When both the late-filing and late-payment penalties apply in the same month, the combined rate is typically 5% for that month, because the filing penalty is reduced by the payment penalty.
segments.tr: - **फाइल न करने का दंड।** यह आमतौर पर अवैतनिक कर का 5% होता है, प्रत्येक महीने या आंशिक महीने के लिए जब रिटर्न देर से आता है, 25% तक। जब देर से फाइल करने और देर से भुगतान करने के दोनों दंड एक ही महीने में लागू होते हैं, तो उस महीने के लिए संयुक्त दर आमतौर पर 5% होती है, क्योंकि फाइलिंग दंड को भुगतान दंड द्वारा कम कर दिया जाता है।

segments.src: - **Minimum penalty.** If a return is more than 60 days late, a minimum penalty applies, which is the lesser of a set dollar amount (adjusted for inflation) or 100% of the tax owed.
segments.tr: - **न्यूनतम दंड।** यदि रिटर्न 60 दिनों से अधिक देर से आता है, तो एक न्यूनतम दंड लागू होता है, जो एक निर्धारित डॉलर राशि (मुद्रास्फीति के लिए समायोजित) या बकाया कर का 100% में से जो भी कम हो, होता है।

segments.src: Because the filing penalty is ten times larger than the payment penalty each month, **filing on time matters even if you cannot pay everything you owe.**
segments.tr: चूंकि फाइलिंग दंड हर महीने भुगतान दंड से दस गुना बड़ा होता है, इसलिए **समय पर फाइल करना मायने रखता है, भले ही आप वह सब कुछ न चुका सकें जो आप पर बकाया है।**

segments.src: ## What to do now
segments.tr: ## अब क्या करें

segments.src: Gather your documents.** Collect W-2s, 1099s, brokerage statements, business records, and any corrected forms.
segments.tr: अपने दस्तावेज इकट्ठा करें।** W-2s, 1099s, ब्रोकरेज स्टेटमेंट, व्यावसायिक रिकॉर्ड, और कोई भी सुधारे गए फॉर्म एकत्र करें।

segments.src: If something is still missing, you can request a copy from the issuer or obtain your income transcript through your IRS online account.
segments.tr: यदि कुछ अभी भी गायब है, तो आप जारीकर्ता से एक प्रति का अनुरोध कर सकते हैं या अपने IRS ऑनलाइन खाते के माध्यम से अपना आय ट्रांसक्रिप्ट प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: Estimate what you owe.** Even a reasonable estimate helps you decide how much to send with your return.
segments.tr: अनुमान लगाएं कि आप पर कितना बकाया है।** एक उचित अनुमान भी आपको यह तय करने में मदद करता है कि अपने रिटर्न के साथ कितना भेजना है।

segments.src: Overpaying slightly is generally better than underpaying, since a refund can be issued later.
segments.tr: थोड़ा अधिक भुगतान करना आमतौर पर कम भुगतान करने से बेहतर है, क्योंकि रिफंड बाद में जारी किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: File by the deadline.** Electronic filing is the fastest route, and e-filed returns are typically acknowledged within a day or two.
segments.tr: समय सीमा तक फाइल करें।** इलेक्ट्रॉनिक फाइलिंग सबसे तेज़ रास्ता है, और ई-फाइल किए गए रिटर्न आमतौर पर एक या दो दिन के भीतर स्वीकार कर लिए जाते हैं।

segments.src: If you are using tax software or a preparer, confirm they can submit before the cutoff, since many offices are busy this week.
segments.tr: यदि आप टैक्स सॉफ्टवेयर या किसी तैयार करने वाले का उपयोग कर रहे हैं, तो पुष्टि करें कि वे कटऑफ से पहले जमा कर सकते हैं, क्योंकि इस सप्ताह कई कार्यालय व्यस्त हैं।

segments.src: Pay what you can.** Payment options include IRS Direct Pay from a bank account, a debit or credit card (processing fees apply), or the Electronic Federal Tax Payment System.
segments.tr: जितना हो सके भुगतान करें।** भुगतान विकल्पों में बैंक खाते से IRS डायरेक्ट पे, डेबिट या क्रेडिट कार्ड (प्रोसेसिंग शुल्क लागू), या इलेक्ट्रॉनिक फेडरल टैक्स पेमेंट सिस्टम शामिल हैं।

segments.src: Paying part of the balance reduces the amount on which penalties and interest are calculated.

segments.tr: 1. **الفوائد.** تفرض مصلحة الضرائب فوائد على الضرائب غير المدفوعة من تاريخ الاستحقاق الأصلي حتى يتم سداد الرصيد بالكامل. يعتمد المعدل على معدل الفيدرالي قصير الأجل مضافاً إليه ثلاث نقاط مئوية ويتم إعادة ضبطه كل ربع سنة. تتراكم الفوائد يومياً.

segments.src: 2. **Failure-to-pay penalty.** This is generally 0.5% of the unpaid tax for each month or partial month the balance remains unpaid, up to a maximum of 25%.
segments.tr: 2. **غرامة عدم الدفع.** تبلغ هذه الغرامة عموماً 0.5% من الضريبة غير المدفوعة عن كل شهر أو جزء من الشهر يظل فيه الرصيد غير مدفوع، وبحد أقصى 25%.

segments.src: ## What happens if you miss October 15
segments.tr: ## ماذا يحدث إذا فاتك موعد 15 أكتوبر

segments.src: Missing the extended deadline adds a third cost on top of the two above:
segments.tr: تؤدي تفويت الموعد النهائي الممدد إلى إضافة تكلفة ثالثة علاوة على التكلفتين المذكورتين أعلاه:

segments.src: - **Failure-to-file penalty.** This is generally 5% of the unpaid tax for each month or partial month the return is late, up to 25%. When both the late-filing and late-payment penalties apply in the same month, the combined rate is typically 5% for that month, because the filing penalty is reduced by the payment penalty.
segments.tr: - **غرامة عدم التقديم.** تبلغ هذه الغرامة عموماً 5% من الضريبة غير المدفوعة عن كل شهر أو جزء من الشهر يكون فيه الإقرار متأخراً، وبحد أقصى 25%. عندما تطبق غرامتا التأخر في التقديم والتأخر في الدفع في نفس الشهر، يكون المعدل المدمج عادةً 5% لهذا الشهر، لأن غرامة التقديم يتم تخفيضها بمقدار غرامة الدفع.

segments.src: - **Minimum penalty.** If a return is more than 60 days late, a minimum penalty applies, which is the lesser of a set dollar amount (adjusted for inflation) or 100% of the tax owed.
segments.tr: - **الحد الأدنى للغرامة.** إذا كان الإقرار متأخراً لأكثر من 60 يوماً، ينطبق حد أدنى للغرامة، وهو الأقل بين مبلغ بالدولار محدد (معدل حسب التضخم) أو 100% من الضريبة المستحقة.

segments.src: Because the filing penalty is ten times larger than the payment penalty each month, **filing on time matters even if you cannot pay everything you owe.**
segments.tr: ونظراً لأن غرامة التقديم أكبر بخس مرات من غرامة الدفع كل شهر، فإن **التقديم في الموعد المحدد يهم حتى لو لم تتمكن من دفع كل ما علي (debt).**

segments.src: ## What to do now
segments.tr: ## ماذا تفعل الآن

segments.src: Gather your documents.** Collect W-2s, 1099s, brokerage statements, business records, and any corrected forms.
segments.tr: اجمع مستنداتك.** اجمع نماذج W-2، و1099، وكشوفات الوساطة، السجلات التجارية، وأي نماذج مصححة.

segments.src: If something is still missing, you can request a copy from the issuer or obtain your income transcript through your IRS online account.
segments.tr: إذا كان هناك شيء مفقود حتى الآن، يمكنك طلب نسخة من الجهة المصدرة أو الحصول على نص الدخل الخاص بك من خلال حسابك عبر الإنترنت في مصلحة الضرائب.

segments.src: Estimate what you owe.** Even a reasonable estimate helps you decide how much to send with your return.
segments.tr: قدر ما عليك.** حتى التقدير المعقول يساعدك على تحديد المبلغ الذي يجب إرساله مع إقرارك.

segments.src: Overpaying slightly is generally better than underpaying, since a refund can be issued later.
segments.tr: الدفع الزائد قليلاً يعتبر عموماً أفضل من الدفع الناقص، حيث يمكن إصدار استرداد لاحقاً.

segments.src: File by the deadline.** Electronic filing is the fastest route, and e-filed returns are typically acknowledged within a day or two.
segments.tr: قم بالتقديم قبل الموعد النهائي.** التقديم الإلكتروني هو الطريقة الأسرع، وعادة ما يتم تأكيد الإقرارات المقدمة إلكترونياً خلال يوم أو يومين.

segments.src: If you are using tax software or a preparer, confirm they can submit before the cutoff, since many offices are busy this week.
segments.tr: إذا كنت تستخدم برنامج ضرائب أو معداً، فتأكد من قدرته على التقديم قبل الموعد النهائي، حيث أن العديد من المكاتب تكون مشغولة هذا الأسبوع.

segments.src: Pay what you can.** Payment options include IRS Direct Pay from a bank account, a debit or credit card (processing fees apply), or the Electronic Federal Tax Payment System.
segments.tr: ادفع ما تستطيع.** تشمل خيارات الدفع الدفع المباشر لمصلحة الضرائب من حساب مصرفي، أو بطاقة خصم أو ائتمان (تطبق رسوم معالجة)، أو نظام الدفع الضريبي الفيدرالي الإلكتروني.

segments.src: Paying part of the balance reduces the amount on which penalties and interest are calculated.
segments.tr: دفع جزء من الرصيد يقلل المبلغ الذي يتم احتساب الغرامات والفوائد عليه.

segments.src: If you cannot pay in full, ask about a payment plan.** The IRS offers short-term payment arrangements and longer-term installment agreements.
segments.tr: إذا لم تتمكن من الدفع بالكامل، فاسأل عن خطة دفع.** تقدم مصلحة الضرائب ترتيبات دفع قصيرة الأجل وا اتفاقيات تقسيط طويلة الأجل.

segments.src: Many individuals can apply online.
segments.tr: يمكن للعديد من الأفراد التقديم عبر الإنترنت.

segments.src: Penalties and interest continue to accrue on an unpaid balance during a plan, but the failure-to-pay rate is generally reduced while an approved installment agreement is in effect.
segments.tr: تستمر الغرامات والفوائد في التراكم على الرصيد غير المدفوع أثناء الخطة، ولكن معدل عدم الدفع يتم تخفيضه عموماً بينما تكون اتفاقية التقسيط الموافقة عليها سارية المفعول.

segments.src: ## Special situations
segments.tr: ## حالات خاصة

segments.src: - **Expecting a refund?** There is generally no failure-to-file penalty when you are owed a refund. However, you usually have three years from the original due date to claim it, so it is still worth filing.
segments.tr: - **تتوقع استرداداً؟** لا توجد عموماً غرامة لعدم التقديم عندما يكون لك مبلغ مسترد. ومع ذلك، لديك عادة ثلاث سنوات من تاريخ الاستحقاق الأصلي للمطالبة به، لذا لا يزال الأمر يستحق التقديم.

segments.src: - **Living abroad?** U.S. citizens and residents living outside the country receive an automatic extension to June 15 and can request additional time, which may run to December 15.
segments.tr: - **تعيش بالخارج؟** يحصل المواطنون الأمريكيون والمقيمون الذين يعيشون خارج البلاد على تمديد تلقائي حتى 15 يونيو ويمكنهم طلب وقت إضافي، والذي قد يمتد إلى 15 ديسمبر.

segments.src: - **Affected by a federally declared disaster?** The IRS often postpones deadlines for affected areas. Check the agency's disaster relief page to see whether your county qualifies and what your specific date is.
segments.tr: - **متأثر بكارثة أعلن عنها اتحادياً؟** غالباً ما تؤجل مصلحة الضرائب المواعيد النهائية للمناطق المتضررة. تحقق من صفحة الإغاثة من الكارثة التابعة للوكالة لمعرفة ما إذا كانت مقاطعتك مؤهلة وما هو تاريخك المحدد.

segments.src: - **Penalty relief.** If you have a reasonable explanation for filing or paying late, or a clean compliance history, you may qualify for penalty abatement. The IRS has an administrative waiver for first-time offenders who meet certain conditions.
segments.tr: - **الإعفاء من الغرامة.** إذا كان لديك تفسير معقول للتأخر في التقديم أو الدفع، أو تاريخ امتثال نظيف، فقد تكون مؤهلاً لتخفيض الغرامة. تمتلك مصلحة الضرائب تنازلاً إدارياً للمخالفين لأول مرة الذين يستوفون شروطاً معينة.

segments.src: ## Common mistakes to avoid
segments.tr: ## الأخطاء الشائعة التي يجب تجنبها

segments.src: - **Assuming the extension covered payment.** It did not.
segments.tr: - **افتراض أن التمديد يغطي الدفع.** لم يكن الأمر كذلك.

segments.src: - **Waiting for a perfect return.** Filing an accurate return on time is better than a late one with every detail polished. You can file an amended return later if needed.
segments.tr: - **انتظار إقرار مثالي.** تقديم إقرار دقيق في الموعد المحدد أفضل من إقرار متأخر مع كل تفصيل منقح. يمكنك تقديم إقرار معدل لاحقاً إذا لزم الأمر.

segments.src: - **Skipping the signature or identity step.** E-filers may need a prior-year adjusted gross income figure or an identity PIN. Have these ready.
segments.tr: - **تخطي خطوة التوقيع أو الهوية.** قد يحتاج مقدمو الإقرارات الإلكترونية إلى رقم إجمالي الدخل المعدل للعام السابق أو رمز PIN للهوية. اجعل هذه جاهزة.

segments.src: - **Ignoring IRS notices.** If you receive a letter, read it carefully and respond by the stated date.
segments.tr: - **تجاهل إشعارات مصلحة الضرائب.** إذا تلقيت رسالة، فاقرأها بعناية واستجب بحلول التاريخ المذكور.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: October 15 is a firm date for extension filers.
segments.tr: 15 أكتوبر هو موعد نهائي صارم لدافعي الضرائب الذين طلبوا تمديداً.

segments.src: Submit your return on time, pay as much as you can, and contact the IRS about a payment arrangement if you cannot cover the full amount.
segments.tr: قدم إقرارك في الوقت المحدد، وادفع قدر ما تستطيع، واتصل بمصلحة الضرائب بخصوص ترتيب الدفع إذا لم تتمكن من تغطية المبلغ بالكامل.

segments.src: Taking those steps will help keep penalties and interest as low as possible.
segments.tr: سيساعدك اتخاذ هذه الخطوات في الحفاظ على الغرامات والفوائد عند أدنى حد ممكن.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not tax advice.
segments.tr: *هذه المقالة مخصصة للمعلومات العامة فقط وليست نصيحة ضريبية.

segments.src: Rules and amounts can change, and individual circumstances vary.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تتغير القواعد والمبالغ، وتختلف الظروف الفردية.

segments.src: Consult a qualified tax professional or visit IRS.gov for guidance specific to your situation.*
segments.tr: استشر متخصص ضرائب مؤهل أو قم بزيارة IRS.gov للحصول على إرشادات خاصة بحالتك.*

fr.title: Date limite de prolongation fiscale du 15 octobre : ce que les déclarants doivent faire avant l'échéance

segments.src: If you requested more time to file your federal income tax return back in April, your extended deadline arrives this week: **Thursday, October 15**.
segments.tr: Si vous avez demandé plus de temps pour produire votre déclaration de revenus fédérale en avril, votre date limite prolongée arrive cette semaine : **le jeudi 15 octobre**.

segments.src: For millions of Americans, this is the last scheduled day to submit a 2025 return without running into additional late-filing consequences.
segments.tr: Pour des millions d'Américains, c'est le dernier jour prévu pour soumettre une déclaration pour 2025 sans s'exposer à des conséquences supplémentaires pour retard de production.

segments.src: Here is a plain-language guide to who is affected, what the extension actually covers, and how to limit penalties and interest.
segments.tr: Voici un guide simple sur les personnes concernées, ce que la prolongation couvre réellement et comment limiter les pénalités et les intérêts.

segments.src: ## Who is affected
segments.tr: ## Qui est concerné

segments.src: The October 15 date applies to taxpayers who filed Form 4868 (for individuals) or otherwise requested an automatic six-month extension by the April deadline.
segments.tr: La date du 15 octobre s'applique aux contribuables qui ont produit le formulaire 4868 (pour les particuliers) ou qui ont demandé une prolongation automatique de six mois avant la date limite d'avril.

segments.src: That group typically includes:
segments.tr: Ce groupe comprend généralement :

segments.src: - **Self-employed workers and freelancers** with complex income and estimated payments to reconcile
segments.tr: - **Travailleurs indépendants et freelances** avec des revenus complexes et des paiements estimés à concilier

segments.src: - **Small business owners and investors** waiting on partnership, S corporation, or brokerage documents
segments.tr: - **Propriétaires de petites entreprises et investisseurs** en attente de documents de sociétés de personnes, de sociétés S ou de courtage

segments.src: - **Households with several income sources**, such as rental income, stock sales, or retirement distributions
segments.tr: - **Foyers ayant plusieurs sources de revenus**, tels que des revenus locatifs, des ventes d'actions ou des distributions de retraite

segments.src: - **People who simply ran out of time** or were missing key forms in the spring
segments.tr: - **Personnes qui ont tout simplement manqué de temps** ou qui n'avaient pas de formulaires clés au printemps

segments.src: If you did not request an extension and have not yet filed, you are already past the original due date, and late-filing and late-payment rules may already be applying to you.
segments.tr: Si vous n'avez pas demandé de prolongation et n'avez pas encore produit votre déclaration, vous avez déjà dépassé la date d'échéance initiale, et les règles de retard de production et de paiement s'appliquent peut-être déjà à vous.

segments.src: Filing as soon as possible is still better than waiting.
segments.tr: Produire sa déclaration le plus tôt possible reste préférable à l'attente.

segments.src: ## An extension to file is not an extension to pay
segments.tr: ## Une prolongation pour produire n'est pas une prolongation pour payer

segments.src: This is the most common point of confusion.
segments.tr: C'est le point de confusion le plus courant.

segments.src: An extension gives you more time to **submit your paperwork**.
segments.tr: Une prolongation vous donne plus de temps pour **soumettre vos documents**.

segments.src: It does not give you more time to **pay what you owe**.
segments.tr: Elle ne vous donne pas plus de temps pour **payer ce que vous devez**.

segments.src: Taxes for 2025 were due in April, and any unpaid balance has been accruing charges since then.
segments.tr: Les impôts pour 2025 étaient dus en avril, et tout solde impayé génère des frais depuis lors.

segments.src: That means two separate costs may already be running on a balance due:
segments.tr: Cela signifie que deux coûts distincts s'appliquent peut-être déjà sur un solde dû :

segments.src: 1. **Interest.** The IRS charges interest on unpaid tax from the original due date until the balance is paid in full. The rate is based on the federal short-term rate plus three percentage points and is reset each quarter. Interest compounds daily.
segments.tr: 1. **Intérêts.** L'IRS facture des intérêts sur l'impôt impayé à compter de la date d'échéance initiale jusqu'au paiement complet du solde. Le taux est basé sur le taux fédéral à court terme plus trois points de pourcentage et est réinitialisé chaque trimestre. Les intérêts sont capitalisés quotidiennement.

segments.src: 2. **Failure-to-pay penalty.** This is generally 0.5% of the unpaid tax for each month or partial month the balance remains unpaid, up to a maximum of 25%.
segments.tr: 2. **Pénalité pour défaut de paiement.** Il s'agit généralement de 0,5 % de l'impôt impayé pour chaque mois ou partie de mois pendant lequel le solde reste impayé, jusqu'à un maximum de 25 %.

segments.src: ## What happens if you miss October 15
segments.tr: ## Que se passe-t-il si vous manquez le 15 octobre

segments.src: Missing the extended deadline adds a third cost on top of the two above:
segments.tr: Manquer la date limite prolongée ajoute un troisième coût en plus des deux précédents :

segments.src: - **Failure-to-file penalty.** This is generally 5% of the unpaid tax for each month or partial month the return is late, up to 25%. When both the late-filing and late-payment penalties apply in the same month, the combined rate is typically 5% for that month, because the filing penalty is reduced by the payment penalty.
segments.tr: - **Pénalité pour défaut de production.** Il s'agit généralement de 5 % de l'impôt impayé pour chaque mois ou partie de mois de retard de la déclaration, jusqu'à 25 %. Lorsque les pénalités pour retard de production et de paiement s'appliquent le même mois, le taux combiné est généralement de 5 % pour ce mois-là, car la pénalité de production est réduite par la pénalité de paiement.

segments.src: - **Minimum penalty.** If a return is more than 60 days late, a minimum penalty applies, which is the lesser of a set dollar amount (adjusted for inflation) or 100% of the tax owed.
segments.tr: - **Pénalité minimale.** Si une déclaration a plus de 60 jours de retard, une pénalité minimale s'applique, qui correspond au moins élevé entre un montant fixe en dollars (ajusté pour l'inflation) ou 100 % de l'impôt dû.

segments.src: Because the filing penalty is ten times larger than the payment penalty each month, **filing on time matters even if you cannot pay everything you owe.**
segments.tr: La pénalité de production étant dix fois plus élevée que la pénalité de paiement chaque mois, **produire à temps est important même si vous ne pouvez pas tout payer.**

segments.src: ## What to do now
segments.tr: ## Que faire maintenant

segments.src: Gather your documents.** Collect W-2s, 1099s, brokerage statements, business records, and any corrected forms.
segments.tr: Rassemblez vos documents.** Récupérez les W-2, 1099, relevés de courtage, registres commerciaux et tout formulaire corrigé.

segments.src: If something is still missing, you can request a copy from the issuer or obtain your income transcript through your IRS online account.
segments.tr: Si un document manque toujours, vous pouvez en demander une copie à l'émetteur ou obtenir votre relevé de revenus via votre compte en ligne IRS.

segments.src: Estimate what you owe.** Even a reasonable estimate helps you decide how much to send with your return.
segments.tr: Estimez ce que vous devez.** Même une estimation raisonnable vous aide à décider du montant à envoyer avec votre déclaration.

segments.src: Overpaying slightly is generally better than underpaying, since a refund can be issued later.
segments.tr: Trop payer légèrement est généralement préférable à payer insuffisamment, puisqu'un remboursement pourra être émis plus tard.

segments.src: File by the deadline.** Electronic filing is the fastest route, and e-filed returns are typically acknowledged within a day or two.
segments.tr: Produisez votre déclaration avant la date limite.** La production électronique est le moyen le plus rapide, et les déclarations électroniques font généralement l'objet d'un accusé de réception en un ou deux jours.

segments.src: If you are using tax software or a preparer, confirm they can submit before the cutoff, since many offices are busy this week.
segments.tr: Si vous utilisez un logiciel fiscal ou un préparateur, confirmez qu'ils peuvent soumettre avant l'échéance, car de nombreux bureaux sont occupés cette semaine.

segments.src: Pay what you can.** Payment options include IRS Direct Pay from a bank account, a debit or credit card (processing fees apply), or the Electronic Federal Tax Payment System.
segments.tr: Payez ce que vous pouvez.** Les options de paiement incluent IRS Direct Pay à partir d'un compte bancaire, une carte de débit ou de crédit (des frais de traitement s'appliquent), ou le système électronique de paiement des impôts fédéraux (EFTPS).

segments.src: Paying part of the balance reduces the amount on which penalties and interest are calculated.
segments.tr: Payer une partie du solde réduit le montant sur lequel les pénalités et les intérêts sont calculés.

segments.src: If you cannot pay in full, ask about a payment plan.** The IRS offers short-term payment arrangements and longer-term installment agreements.
segments.tr: Si vous ne pouvez pas payer en totalité, renseignez-vous sur un plan de paiement.** L'IRS propose des arrangements de paiement à court terme et des accords de versement à plus long terme.

segments.src: Many individuals can apply online.
segments.tr: De nombreux particuliers peuvent faire une demande en ligne.

segments.src: Penalties and interest continue to accrue on an unpaid balance during a plan, but the failure-to-pay rate is generally reduced while an approved installment agreement is in effect.
segments.tr: Les pénalités et les intérêts continuent de s'accumuler sur un solde impayé pendant un plan, mais le taux de défaut de paiement est généralement réduit lorsqu'un accord de versement approuvé est en vigueur.

segments.src: ## Special situations
segments.tr: ## Situations particulières

segments.src: - **Expecting a refund?** There is generally no failure-to-file penalty when you are owed a refund. However, you usually have three years from the original due date to claim it, so it is still worth filing.
segments.tr: - **Vous attendez un remboursement ?** Il n'y a généralement pas de pénalité pour défaut de production lorsque l'on vous doit un remboursement. Cependant, vous disposez généralement de trois ans à compter de la date d'échéance initiale pour le réclamer, il est donc toujours utile de produire votre déclaration.

segments.src: - **Living abroad?** U.S. citizens and residents living outside the country receive an automatic extension to June 15 and can request additional time, which may run to December 15.
segments.tr: - **Vous vivez à l'étranger ?** Les citoyens américains et les résidents vivant hors du pays bénéficient d'une prolongation automatique jusqu'au 15 juin et peuvent demander un délai supplémentaire, qui peut aller jusqu'au 15 décembre.

segments.src: - **Affected by a federally declared disaster?** The IRS often postpones deadlines for affected areas. Check the agency's disaster relief page to see whether your county qualifies and what your specific date is.
segments.tr: - **Touché par une catastrophe déclarée au niveau fédéral ?** L'IRS reporte souvent les dates limites pour les zones touchées. Consultez la page de secours en cas de catastrophe de l'agence pour voir si votre comté est éligible et quelle est votre date spécifique.

segments.src: - **Penalty relief.** If you have a reasonable explanation for filing or paying late, or a clean compliance history, you may qualify for penalty abatement. The IRS has an administrative waiver for first-time offenders who meet certain conditions.
segments.tr: - **Allègement des pénalités.** Si vous avez une explication raisonnable pour un dépôt ou un paiement tardif, ou un historique de conformité propre, vous pourriez être admissible à une remise de pénalité. L'IRS dispose d'une dispense administrative pour les primo-délinquants qui remplissent certaines conditions.

segments.src: ## Common mistakes to avoid
segments.tr: ## Erreurs courantes à éviter

segments.src: - **Assuming the extension covered payment.** It did not.
segments.tr: - **Supposer que la prolongation couvrait le paiement.** Ce n'était pas le cas.

segments.src: - **Waiting for a perfect return.** Filing an accurate return on time is better than a late one with every detail polished. You can file an amended return later if needed.
segments.tr: - **Attendre une déclaration parfaite.** Produire une déclaration exacte à temps vaut mieux qu'une déclaration tardive avec chaque détail peaufiné. Vous pouvez produire une déclaration modificative plus tard si nécessaire.

segments.src: - **Skipping the signature or identity step.** E-filers may need a prior-year adjusted gross income figure or an identity PIN. Have these ready.

pt.title: Prazo de Extensão Fiscal de 15 de Outubro: O que os Contribuintes Precisam Fazer Antes do Limite

segments.src: If you requested more time to file your federal income tax return back in April, your extended deadline arrives this week: **Thursday, October 15**.
segments.tr: Se você solicitou mais tempo para enviar sua declaração de imposto de renda federal em abril, seu prazo estendido chega esta semana: **quinta-feira, 15 de outubro**.

segments.src: For millions of Americans, this is the last scheduled day to submit a 2025 return without running into additional late-filing consequences.
segments.tr: Para milhões de americanos, este é o último dia agendado para enviar uma declaração de 2025 sem enfrentar consequências adicionais por atraso no envio.

segments.src: Here is a plain-language guide to who is affected, what the extension actually covers, and how to limit penalties and interest.
segments.tr: Aqui está um guia em linguagem simples sobre quem é afetado, o que a extensão realmente cobre e como limitar multas e juros.

segments.src: ## Who is affected
segments.tr: ## Quem é afetado

segments.src: The October 15 date applies to taxpayers who filed Form 4868 (for individuals) or otherwise requested an automatic six-month extension by the April deadline.
segments.tr: A data de 15 de outubro aplica-se aos contribuintes que enviaram o Formulário 4868 (para indivíduos) ou que solicitaram uma extensão automática de seis meses até o prazo de abril.

segments.src: That group typically includes:
segments.tr: Esse grupo normalmente inclui:

segments.src: - **Self-employed workers and freelancers** with complex income and estimated payments to reconcile
segments.tr: - **Trabalhadores autônomos e freelancers** com renda complexa e pagamentos estimados a conciliar

segments.src: - **Small business owners and investors** waiting on partnership, S corporation, or brokerage documents
segments.tr: - **Proprietários de pequenas empresas e investidores** aguardando documentos de parceria, corporação S ou corretoras

segments.src: - **Households with several income sources**, such as rental income, stock sales, or retirement distributions
segments.tr: - **Famílias com várias fontes de renda**, como renda de aluguel, vendas de ações ou distribuições de aposentadoria

segments.src: - **People who simply ran out of time** or were missing key forms in the spring
segments.tr: - **Pessoas que simplesmente ficaram sem tempo** ou que estavam com formulários importantes faltando na primavera

segments.src: If you did not request an extension and have not yet filed, you are already past the original due date, and late-filing and late-payment rules may already be applying to you.
segments.tr: Se você não solicitou uma extensão e ainda não enviou a declaração, você já passou do prazo original, e as regras de atraso no envio e atraso no pagamento podem já estar sendo aplicadas a você.

segments.src: Filing as soon as possible is still better than waiting.
segments.tr: Enviar o quanto antes ainda é melhor do que esperar.

segments.src: ## An extension to file is not an extension to pay
segments.tr: ## Uma extensão para enviar não é uma extensão para pagar

segments.src: This is the most common point of confusion.
segments.tr: Este é o ponto de confusão mais comum.

segments.src: An extension gives you more time to **submit your paperwork**.
segments.tr: Uma extensão lhe dá mais tempo para **enviar sua papelada**.

segments.src: It does not give you more time to **pay what you owe**.
segments.tr: Ela não lhe dá mais tempo para **pagar o que você deve**.

segments.src: Taxes for 2025 were due in April, and any unpaid balance has been accruing charges since then.
segments.tr: Os impostos de 2025 venceram em abril, e qualquer saldo não pago vem acumulando encargos desde então.

segments.src: That means two separate costs may already be running on a balance due:
segments.tr: Isso significa que dois custos separados podem já estar incidindo sobre um saldo devedor:

segments.src: 1. **Interest.** The IRS charges interest on unpaid tax from the original due date until the balance is paid in full. The rate is based on the federal short-term rate plus three percentage points and is reset each quarter. Interest compounds daily.
segments.tr: 1. **Juros.** O IRS cobra juros sobre impostos não pagos desde a data de vencimento original até que o saldo seja pago integralmente. A taxa é baseada na taxa federal de curto prazo mais três pontos percentuais e é redefinida a cada trimestre. Os juros são compostos diariamente.

segments.src: 2. **Failure-to-pay penalty.** This is generally 0.5% of the unpaid tax for each month or partial month the balance remains unpaid, up to a maximum of 25%.
segments.tr: 2. **Multa por não pagamento.** Geralmente é de 0,5% do imposto não pago para cada mês ou fração de mês em que o saldo permanece não pago, até um máximo de 25%.

segments.src: ## What happens if you miss October 15
segments.tr: ## O que acontece se você perder o dia 15 de outubro

segments.src: Missing the extended deadline adds a third cost on top of the two above:
segments.tr: Perder o prazo estendido adiciona um terceiro custo aos dois acima:

segments.src: - **Failure-to-file penalty.** This is generally 5% of the unpaid tax for each month or partial month the return is late, up to 25%. When both the late-filing and late-payment penalties apply in the same month, the combined rate is typically 5% for that month, because the filing penalty is reduced by the payment penalty.
segments.tr: - **Multa por não envio.** Geralmente é de 5% do imposto não pago para cada mês ou fração de mês em que a declaração está atrasada, até 25%. Quando tanto a multa por atraso no envio quanto a multa por atraso no pagamento se aplicam no mesmo mês, a taxa combinada é normalmente de 5% para aquele mês, porque a multa de envio é reduzida pela multa de pagamento.

segments.src: - **Minimum penalty.** If a return is more than 60 days late, a minimum penalty applies, which is the lesser of a set dollar amount (adjusted for inflation) or 100% of the tax owed.
segments.tr: - **Multa mínima.** Se uma declaração estiver com mais de 60 dias de atraso, aplica-se uma multa mínima, que é o menor valor entre um montante fixo (ajustado pela inflação) ou 100% do imposto devido.

segments.src: Because the filing penalty is ten times larger than the payment penalty each month, **filing on time matters even if you cannot pay everything you owe.**
segments.tr: Como a multa por não envio é dez vezes maior que a multa por não pagamento a cada mês, **enviar no prazo é importante mesmo que você não possa pagar tudo o que deve.**

segments.src: ## What to do now
segments.tr: ## O que fazer agora

segments.src: Gather your documents.** Collect W-2s, 1099s, brokerage statements, business records, and any corrected forms.
segments.tr: Reúna seus documentos.** Colete W-2s, 1099s, extratos de corretoras, registros comerciais e quaisquer formulários corrigidos.

segments.src: If something is still missing, you can request a copy from the issuer or obtain your income transcript through your IRS online account.
segments.tr: Se algo ainda estiver faltando, você pode solicitar uma cópia ao emissor ou obter sua transcrição de renda através da sua conta online do IRS.

segments.src: Estimate what you owe.** Even a reasonable estimate helps you decide how much to send with your return.
segments.tr: Estime o que você deve.** Mesmo uma estimativa razoável ajuda você a decidir quanto enviar com sua declaração.

segments.src: Overpaying slightly is generally better than underpaying, since a refund can be issued later.
segments.tr: Pagar um pouco a mais geralmente é melhor do que pagar a menos, já que um reembolso pode ser emitido posteriormente.

segments.src: File by the deadline.** Electronic filing is the fastest route, and e-filed returns are typically acknowledged within a day or two.
segments.tr: Envie até o prazo final.** O envio eletrônico é a rota mais rápida, e as declarações enviadas eletronicamente são geralmente confirmadas dentro de um ou dois dias.

segments.src: If you are using tax software or a preparer, confirm they can submit before the cutoff, since many offices are busy this week.
segments.tr: Se você estiver usando um software de impostos ou um preparador, confirme se eles podem enviar antes do limite, já que muitos escritórios estão ocupados esta semana.

segments.src: Pay what you can.** Payment options include IRS Direct Pay from a bank account, a debit or credit card (processing fees apply), or the Electronic Federal Tax Payment System.
segments.tr: Pague o que puder.** As opções de pagamento incluem o IRS Direct Pay de uma conta bancária, um cartão de débito ou crédito (taxas de processamento se aplicam) ou o Electronic Federal Tax Payment System.

segments.src: Paying part of the balance reduces the amount on which penalties and interest are calculated.
segments.tr: Pagar parte do saldo reduz o valor sobre o qual as multas e juros são calculados.

segments.src: If you cannot pay in full, ask about a payment plan.** The IRS offers short-term payment arrangements and longer-term installment agreements.
segments.tr: Se você não puder pagar integralmente, pergunte sobre um plano de pagamento.** O IRS oferece acordos de pagamento de curto prazo e acordos de parcelamento de longo prazo.

segments.src: Many individuals can apply online.
segments.tr: Muitos indivíduos podem se inscrever online.

segments.src: Penalties and interest continue to accrue on an unpaid balance during a plan, but the failure-to-pay rate is generally reduced while an approved installment agreement is in effect.
segments.tr: Multas e juros continuam a incidir sobre um saldo não pago durante um plano, mas a taxa de não pagamento é geralmente reduzida enquanto um acordo de parcelamento aprovado estiver em vigor.

segments.src: ## Special situations
segments.tr: ## Situações especiais

segments.src: - **Expecting a refund?** There is generally no failure-to-file penalty when you are owed a refund. However, you usually have three years from the original due date to claim it, so it is still worth filing.
segments.tr: - **Esperando um reembolso?** Geralmente não há multa por não envio quando você tem direito a um reembolso. No entanto, você geralmente tem três anos a partir da data de vencimento original para reivindicá-lo, então ainda vale a pena enviar.

segments.src: - **Living abroad?** U.S. citizens and residents living outside the country receive an automatic extension to June 15 and can request additional time, which may run to December 15.
segments.tr: - **Morando no exterior?** Cidadãos e residentes dos EUA que moram fora do país recebem uma extensão automática até 15 de junho e podem solicitar tempo adicional, que pode ir até 15 de dezembro.

segments.src: - **Affected by a federally declared disaster?** The IRS often postpones deadlines for affected areas. Check the agency's disaster relief page to see whether your county qualifies and what your specific date is.
segments.tr: - **Afetado por um desastre declarado pelo governo federal?** O IRS frequentemente adia prazos para áreas afetadas. Verifique a página de alívio de desastres da agência para ver se seu condado se qualifica e qual é sua data específica.

segments.src: - **Penalty relief.** If you have a reasonable explanation for filing or paying late, or a clean compliance history, you may qualify for penalty abatement. The IRS has an administrative waiver for first-time offenders who meet certain conditions.
segments.tr: - **Alívio de multa.** Se você tiver uma explicação razoável para o envio ou pagamento atrasado, ou um histórico de conformidade limpo, você pode se qualificar para o perdão de multa. O IRS tem uma isenção administrativa para infratores de primeira viagem que atendem a certas condições.

segments.src: ## Common mistakes to avoid
segments.tr: ## Erros comuns a evitar

segments.src: - **Assuming the extension covered payment.** It did not.
segments.tr: - **Assumir que a extensão cobria o pagamento.** Não cobria.

segments.src: - **Waiting for a perfect return.** Filing an accurate return on time is better than a late one with every detail polished. You can file an amended return later if needed.
segments.tr: - **Esperar por uma declaração perfeita.** Enviar uma declaração precisa no prazo é melhor do que uma atrasada com cada detalhe polido. Você pode enviar uma declaração retificadora mais tarde, se necessário.

segments.src: - **Skipping the signature or identity step.** E-filers may need a prior-year adjusted gross income figure or an identity PIN. Have these ready.
segments.tr: - **Pular a etapa de assinatura ou identidade.** Os declarantes eletrônicos podem precisar de um valor de renda bruta ajustada do ano anterior ou um PIN de identidade. Tenha isso em mãos.

segments.src: - **Ignoring IRS notices.** If you receive a letter, read it carefully and respond by the stated date.
segments.tr: - **Ignorar avisos do IRS.** Se você receber uma carta, leia-a com atenção e responda até a data indicada.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## O ponto principal

segments.src: October 15 is a firm date for extension filers.
segments.tr: 15 de outubro é uma data firme para quem envia com extensão.

segments.src: Submit your return on time, pay as much as you can, and contact the IRS about a payment arrangement if you cannot cover the full amount.
segments.tr: Envie sua declaração no prazo, pague o máximo que puder e entre em contato com o IRS sobre um acordo de pagamento se não puder cobrir o valor total.

segments.src: Taking those steps will help keep penalties and interest as low as possible.
segments.tr: Tomar essas medidas ajudará a manter as multas e juros o mais baixos possível.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not tax advice.
segments.tr: *Este artigo é apenas para fins informativos gerais e não constitui aconselhamento fiscal.

segments.src: Rules and amounts can change, and individual circumstances vary.
segments.tr: Regras e valores podem mudar, e as circunstâncias individuais variam.

segments.src: Consult a qualified tax professional or visit IRS.gov for guidance specific to your situation.*
segments.tr: Consulte um profissional fiscal qualificado ou visite IRS.gov para orientações específicas para sua situação.*

segments.tr: Berikut adalah panduan bahasa sederhana mengenai siapa saja yang terdampak, apa yang sebenarnya dicakup oleh perpanjangan tersebut, dan cara membatasi denda serta bunga.

segments.src: ## Who is affected

segments.src: The October 15 date applies to taxpayers who filed Form 4868 (for individuals) or otherwise requested an automatic six-month extension by the April deadline.
segments.tr: Tanggal 15 Oktober berlaku bagi wajib pajak yang mengajukan Formulir 4868 (untuk individu) atau meminta perpanjangan otomatis enam bulan sebelum batas waktu bulan April.

segments.src: That group typically includes:

segments.src: - **Small business owners and investors** waiting on partnership, S corporation, or brokerage documents
