segments.tr: - **Rumah tangga dengan beberapa sumber pendapatan**, seperti pendapatan sewa, penjualan saham, atau distribusi pensiun

segments.src: - **People who simply ran out of time** or were missing key forms in the spring
segments.tr: - **Orang yang kehabisan waktu** atau kehilangan formulir penting di musim semi

segments.src: If you did not request an extension and have not yet filed, you are already past the original due date, and late-filing and late-payment rules may already be applying to you.
segments.tr: Jika Anda tidak meminta perpanjangan dan belum mengajukan SPT, Anda sudah melewati batas waktu asli, dan aturan keterlambatan pengajuan serta keterlambatan pembayaran mungkin sudah berlaku bagi Anda.

segments.src: Filing as soon as possible is still better than waiting.
segments.tr: Mengajukan sesegera mungkin tetap lebih baik daripada menunggu.

segments.src: ## An extension to file is not an extension to pay
segments.tr: ## Perpanjangan waktu pengajuan bukan perpanjangan waktu pembayaran

segments.src: This is the most common point of confusion.
segments.tr: Ini adalah poin kebingungan yang paling umum.

segments.src: An extension gives you more time to **submit your paperwork**.
segments.tr: Perpanjangan memberi Anda lebih banyak waktu untuk **menyerahkan dokumen Anda**.

segments.src: It does not give you more time to **pay what you owe**.
segments.tr: Ini tidak memberi Anda lebih banyak waktu untuk **membayar apa yang Anda utang**.

segments.src: Taxes for 2025 were due in April, and any unpaid balance has been accruing charges since then.
segments.tr: Pajak untuk tahun 2025 jatuh tempo pada bulan April, dan saldo yang belum dibayar telah dikenakan biaya sejak saat itu.

segments.src: That means two separate costs may already be running on a balance due:
segments.tr: Itu berarti dua biaya terpisah mungkin sudah berjalan pada saldo terutang:

segments.src: 1. **Interest.** The IRS charges interest on unpaid tax from the original due date until the balance is paid in full. The rate is based on the federal short-term rate plus three percentage points and is reset each quarter. Interest compounds daily.
segments.tr: 1. **Bunga.** IRS mengenakan bunga atas pajak yang belum dibayar sejak tanggal jatuh tempo asli hingga saldo dilunasi sepenuhnya. Tarifnya didasarkan pada tarif jangka pendek federal ditambah tiga poin persentase dan diatur ulang setiap kuartal. Bunga dihitung secara harian.

segments.src: 2. **Failure-to-pay penalty.** This is generally 0.5% of the unpaid tax for each month or partial month the balance remains unpaid, up to a maximum of 25%.
segments.tr: 2. **Denda karena tidak membayar.** Ini biasanya 0,5% dari pajak yang belum dibayar untuk setiap bulan atau sebagian bulan saldo tetap belum dibayar, hingga maksimum 25%.

segments.src: ## What happens if you miss October 15
segments.tr: ## Apa yang terjadi jika Anda melewatkan 15 Oktober

segments.src: Missing the extended deadline adds a third cost on top of the two above:
segments.tr: Melewatkan batas waktu perpanjangan menambah biaya ketiga di atas dua biaya di atas:

segments.src: - **Failure-to-file penalty.** This is generally 5% of the unpaid tax for each month or partial month the return is late, up to 25%. When both the late-filing and late-payment penalties apply in the same month, the combined rate is typically 5% for that month, because the filing penalty is reduced by the payment penalty.
segments.tr: - **Denda karena tidak mengajukan.** Ini biasanya 5% dari pajak yang belum dibayar untuk setiap bulan atau sebagian bulan SPT terlambat, hingga 25%. Ketika denda keterlambatan pengajuan dan keterlambatan pembayaran berlaku pada bulan yang sama, tarif gabungannya biasanya 5% untuk bulan tersebut, karena denda pengajuan dikurangi oleh denda pembayaran.

segments.src: - **Minimum penalty.** If a return is more than 60 days late, a minimum penalty applies, which is the lesser of a set dollar amount (adjusted for inflation) or 100% of the tax owed.
segments.tr: - **Denda minimum.** Jika SPT terlambat lebih dari 60 hari, denda minimum berlaku, yaitu yang lebih rendah antara jumlah dolar yang ditetapkan (disesuaikan dengan inflasi) atau 100% dari pajak yang terutang.

segments.src: Because the filing penalty is ten times larger than the payment penalty each month, **filing on time matters even if you cannot pay everything you owe.**
segments.tr: Karena denda pengajuan sepuluh kali lebih besar daripada denda pembayaran setiap bulannya, **mengajukan tepat waktu itu penting meskipun Anda tidak dapat membayar semua yang Anda utang.**

segments.src: ## What to do now
segments.tr: ## Apa yang harus dilakukan sekarang

segments.src: Gather your documents.** Collect W-2s, 1099s, brokerage statements, business records, and any corrected forms.
segments.tr: Kumpulkan dokumen Anda.** Kumpulkan W-2, 1099, laporan pialang, catatan bisnis, dan formulir yang telah dikoreksi.

segments.src: If something is still missing, you can request a copy from the issuer or obtain your income transcript through your IRS online account.
segments.tr: Jika ada sesuatu yang masih kurang, Anda dapat meminta salinannya dari penerbit atau mendapatkan transkrip pendapatan Anda melalui akun online IRS Anda.

segments.src: Estimate what you owe.** Even a reasonable estimate helps you decide how much to send with your return.
segments.tr: Perkirakan apa yang Anda utang.** Bahkan estimasi yang masuk akal membantu Anda memutuskan berapa banyak yang harus dikirimkan bersama SPT Anda.

segments.src: Overpaying slightly is generally better than underpaying, since a refund can be issued later.
segments.tr: Membayar sedikit berlebih biasanya lebih baik daripada kurang bayar, karena pengembalian dana dapat diterbitkan nanti.

segments.src: File by the deadline.** Electronic filing is the fastest route, and e-filed returns are typically acknowledged within a day or two.
segments.tr: Ajukan sebelum batas waktu.** Pengajuan elektronik adalah rute tercepat, dan SPT yang diajukan secara elektronik biasanya diakui dalam satu atau dua hari.

segments.src: If you are using tax software or a preparer, confirm they can submit before the cutoff, since many offices are busy this week.
segments.tr: Jika Anda menggunakan perangkat lunak pajak atau penyedia jasa, pastikan mereka dapat mengirimkannya sebelum batas waktu, karena banyak kantor sibuk minggu ini.

segments.src: Pay what you can.** Payment options include IRS Direct Pay from a bank account, a debit or credit card (processing fees apply), or the Electronic Federal Tax Payment System.
segments.tr: Bayar semampu Anda.** Opsi pembayaran termasuk IRS Direct Pay dari rekening bank, kartu debit atau kredit (biaya pemrosesan berlaku), atau Electronic Federal Tax Payment System.

segments.src: Paying part of the balance reduces the amount on which penalties and interest are calculated.
segments.tr: Membayar sebagian saldo mengurangi jumlah yang menjadi dasar perhitungan denda dan bunga.

segments.src: If you cannot pay in full, ask about a payment plan.** The IRS offers short-term payment arrangements and longer-term installment agreements.
segments.tr: Jika Anda tidak dapat membayar penuh, tanyakan tentang rencana pembayaran.** IRS menawarkan pengaturan pembayaran jangka pendek dan perjanjian cicilan jangka panjang.

segments.src: Many individuals can apply online.
segments.tr: Banyak individu dapat mendaftar secara online.

segments.src: Penalties and interest continue to accrue on an unpaid balance during a plan, but the failure-to-pay rate is generally reduced while an approved installment agreement is in effect.
segments.tr: Denda dan bunga terus bertambah pada saldo yang belum dibayar selama rencana berlangsung, tetapi tarif karena tidak membayar biasanya dikurangi selama perjanjian cicilan yang disetujui berlaku.

segments.src: ## Special situations
segments.tr: ## Situasi khusus

segments.src: - **Expecting a refund?** There is generally no failure-to-file penalty when you are owed a refund. However, you usually have three years from the original due date to claim it, so it is still worth filing.
segments.tr: - **Mengharapkan pengembalian dana?** Biasanya tidak ada denda karena tidak mengajukan jika Anda berhak atas pengembalian dana. Namun, Anda biasanya memiliki waktu tiga tahun sejak tanggal jatuh tempo asli untuk mengklaimnya, jadi tetap layak untuk mengajukan.

segments.src: - **Living abroad?** U.S. citizens and residents living outside the country receive an automatic extension to June 15 and can request additional time, which may run to December 15.
segments.tr: - **Tinggal di luar negeri?** Warga negara AS dan penduduk yang tinggal di luar negeri menerima perpanjangan otomatis hingga 15 Juni dan dapat meminta waktu tambahan, yang mungkin berlangsung hingga 15 Desember.

segments.src: - **Affected by a federally declared disaster?** The IRS often postpones deadlines for affected areas. Check the agency's disaster relief page to see whether your county qualifies and what your specific date is.
segments.tr: - **Terdampak oleh bencana yang dinyatakan secara federal?** IRS sering menunda batas waktu untuk daerah yang terdampak. Periksa halaman bantuan bencana agensi untuk melihat apakah wilayah Anda memenuhi syarat dan apa tanggal spesifik Anda.

segments.src: - **Penalty relief.** If you have a reasonable explanation for filing or paying late, or a clean compliance history, you may qualify for penalty abatement. The IRS has an administrative waiver for first-time offenders who meet certain conditions.
segments.tr: - **Keringanan denda.** Jika Anda memiliki penjelasan yang masuk akal untuk pengajuan atau pembayaran yang terlambat, atau riwayat kepatuhan yang bersih, Anda mungkin memenuhi syarat untuk pengurangan denda. IRS memiliki pengabaian administratif untuk pelanggar pertama kali yang memenuhi kondisi tertentu.

segments.src: ## Common mistakes to avoid
segments.tr: ## Kesalahan umum yang harus dihindari

segments.src: - **Assuming the extension covered payment.** It did not.
segments.tr: - **Mengasumsikan perpanjangan mencakup pembayaran.** Tidak.

segments.src: - **Waiting for a perfect return.** Filing an accurate return on time is better than a late one with every detail polished. You can file an amended return later if needed.
segments.tr: - **Menunggu SPT yang sempurna.** Mengajukan SPT yang akurat tepat waktu lebih baik daripada yang terlambat dengan setiap detail yang dipoles. Anda dapat mengajukan SPT perubahan nanti jika diperlukan.

segments.src: - **Skipping the signature or identity step.** E-filers may need a prior-year adjusted gross income figure or an identity PIN. Have these ready.
segments.tr: - **Melewatkan langkah tanda tangan atau identitas.** Pengaju elektronik mungkin memerlukan angka pendapatan kotor yang disesuaikan tahun sebelumnya atau PIN identitas. Siapkan ini.

segments.src: - **Ignoring IRS notices.** If you receive a letter, read it carefully and respond by the stated date.
segments.tr: - **Mengabaikan pemberitahuan IRS.** Jika Anda menerima surat, baca dengan cermat dan tanggapi pada tanggal yang tertera.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: October 15 is a firm date for extension filers.
segments.tr: 15 Oktober adalah tanggal pasti bagi pengaju perpanjangan.

segments.src: Submit your return on time, pay as much as you can, and contact the IRS about a payment arrangement if you cannot cover the full amount.
segments.tr: Kirimkan SPT Anda tepat waktu, bayar sebanyak yang Anda bisa, dan hubungi IRS mengenai pengaturan pembayaran jika Anda tidak dapat menutupi jumlah penuh.

segments.src: Taking those steps will help keep penalties and interest as low as possible.
segments.tr: Mengambil langkah-langkah tersebut akan membantu menjaga denda dan bunga serendah mungkin.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not tax advice.
segments.tr: *Artikel ini hanya untuk informasi umum dan bukan merupakan nasihat pajak.

segments.src: Rules and amounts can change, and individual circumstances vary.
segments.tr: Aturan dan jumlah dapat berubah, dan keadaan individu bervariasi.

segments.src: Consult a qualified tax professional or visit IRS.gov for guidance specific to your situation.*
segments.tr: Konsultasikan dengan profesional pajak yang berkualifikasi atau kunjungi IRS.gov untuk panduan khusus situasi Anda.*

ja.title: 10月15日の納税延長期限：期限前に申告者が行うべきこと

segments.src: If you requested more time to file your federal income tax return back in April, your extended deadline arrives this week: **Thursday, October 15**.
segments.tr: もし4月に連邦所得税の申告期限の延長を申請していた場合、延長された期限が今週やってきます：**10月15日（木）**。

segments.src: For millions of Americans, this is the last scheduled day to submit a 2025 return without running into additional late-filing consequences.
segments.tr: 何百万人ものアメリカ人にとって、これは追加の期限後申告のペナルティなしで2025年分の申告書を提出するための最後の予定日です。

segments.src: Here is a plain-language guide to who is affected, what the extension actually covers, and how to limit penalties and interest.
segments.tr: ここでは、誰が影響を受けるのか、延長が実際に何をカバーしているのか、そしてペナルティや利息を抑える方法についての分かりやすいガイドを提供します。

segments.src: ## Who is affected
segments.tr: ## 影響を受ける人

segments.src: The October 15 date applies to taxpayers who filed Form 4868 (for individuals) or otherwise requested an automatic six-month extension by the April deadline.
segments.tr: 10月15日という日付は、フォーム4868（個人用）を提出したか、あるいは4月の期限までに自動的な6ヶ月の延長を申請した納税者に適用されます。

segments.src: That group typically includes:
segments.tr: そのグループには通常以下が含まれます：

segments.src: - **Self-employed workers and freelancers** with complex income and estimated payments to reconcile
segments.tr: - **自営業者およびフリーランス**：複雑な所得や見積納税額の精算が必要な人

segments.src: - **Small business owners and investors** waiting on partnership, S corporation, or brokerage documents
segments.tr: - **小規模事業者のオーナーおよび投資家**：パートナーシップ、Sコーポレーション、証券会社の書類を待っている人

segments.src: - **Households with several income sources**, such as rental income, stock sales, or retirement distributions
segments.tr: - **複数の所得源を持つ世帯**：賃貸収入、株式売却、退職金分配金などがある人

segments.src: - **People who simply ran out of time** or were missing key forms in the spring
segments.tr: - **単に時間が足りなくなった人**、または春に重要な書類が不足していた人

segments.src: If you did not request an extension and have not yet filed, you are already past the original due date, and late-filing and late-payment rules may already be applying to you.
segments.tr: 延長を申請しておらず、まだ申告していない場合、すでに本来の期限を過ぎており、期限後申告や期限内未納のルールがすでに適用されている可能性があります。

segments.src: Filing as soon as possible is still better than waiting.
segments.tr: 待つよりも、できるだけ早く申告する方が常に優れています。

segments.src: ## An extension to file is not an extension to pay
segments.tr: ## 申告の延長は納税の延長ではない

segments.src: This is the most common point of confusion.
segments.tr: これは最もよくある誤解です。

segments.src: An extension gives you more time to **submit your paperwork**.
segments.tr: 延長によって、**書類を提出する**ための時間が増えます。

segments.src: It does not give you more time to **pay what you owe**.
segments.tr: しかし、**負債を支払う**ための時間が増えるわけではありません。

segments.src: Taxes for 2025 were due in April, and any unpaid balance has been accruing charges since then.
segments.tr: 2025年分の税金は4月に期限を迎えており、未払いの残高にはそれ以降ずっと料金が加算されています。

segments.src: That means two separate costs may already be running on a balance due:
segments.tr: つまり、未払い残高に対してすでに2つの異なるコストが発生している可能性があります：

segments.src: 1. **Interest.** The IRS charges interest on unpaid tax from the original due date until the balance is paid in full. The rate is based on the federal short-term rate plus three percentage points and is reset each quarter. Interest compounds daily.
segments.tr: 1. **利息。** IRSは、本来の期限から残高が全額支払われるまで、未納税金に対して利息を課します。利率は連邦短期金利に3パーセントを加えたもので、四半期ごとにリセットされます。利息は毎日複利計算されます。

segments.src: 2. **Failure-to-pay penalty.** This is generally 0.5% of the unpaid tax for each month or partial month the balance remains unpaid, up to a maximum of 25%.
segments.tr: 2. **未納ペナルティ。** これは通常、残高が未払いのままの月、またはその一部の月ごとに、未納税金の0.5%であり、最大25%までとなります。

segments.src: ## What happens if you miss October 15
segments.tr: ## 10月15日を逃した場合どうなるか

segments.src: Missing the extended deadline adds a third cost on top of the two above:
segments.tr: 延長期限を逃すと、上記の2つに加えて3番目のコストが追加されます：

segments.src: - **Failure-to-file penalty.** This is generally 5% of the unpaid tax for each month or partial month the return is late, up to 25%. When both the late-filing and late-payment penalties apply in the same month, the combined rate is typically 5% for that month, because the filing penalty is reduced by the payment penalty.
segments.tr: - **未申告ペナルティ。** これは通常、申告が遅れた月またはその一部の月ごとに、未納税金の5%であり、最大25%までとなります。期限後申告と未納のペナルティが同じ月に両方適用される場合、申告ペナルティが納税ペナルティによって減額されるため、その月の合算率は通常5%になります。

segments.src: - **Minimum penalty.** If a return is more than 60 days late, a minimum penalty applies, which is the lesser of a set dollar amount (adjusted for inflation) or 100% of the tax owed.
segments.tr: - **最低ペナルティ。** 申告書が60日以上遅れた場合、最低ペナルティが適用されます。これは、設定された金額（インフレ調整済み）または負債額の100%のいずれか低い方です。

segments.src: Because the filing penalty is ten times larger than the payment penalty each month, **filing on time matters even if you cannot pay everything you owe.**
segments.tr: 申告ペナルティは納税ペナルティの毎月の10倍の大きさであるため、**支払うべき全額を支払えない場合でも、期日通りに申告することが重要です。**

segments.src: ## What to do now
segments.tr: ## 今すべきこと

segments.src: Gather your documents.** Collect W-2s, 1099s, brokerage statements, business records, and any corrected forms.
segments.tr: 書類を集める。** W-2、1099、証券口座の明細書、事業記録、および修正されたフォームを収集します。

segments.src: If something is still missing, you can request a copy from the issuer or obtain your income transcript through your IRS online account.
segments.tr: 何かがまだ見つからない場合は、発行元からコピーを請求するか、IRSのオンラインアカウントを通じて所得のトランスクリプトを取得できます。

segments.src: Estimate what you owe.** Even a reasonable estimate helps you decide how much to send with your return.
segments.tr: 負債額を見積もる。** 合理的な見積もりであっても、申告書と一緒にいくら送付すべきかを決定するのに役立ちます。

segments.src: Overpaying slightly is generally better than underpaying, since a refund can be issued later.
segments.tr: 還付金は後日発行できるため、少額多く支払うことは、少なく支払うことよりも一般的に優れています。

segments.src: File by the deadline.** Electronic filing is the fastest route, and e-filed returns are typically acknowledged within a day or two.
segments.tr: 期限までに申告する。** 電子申告は最も早いルートであり、電子申告された書類は通常1〜2日以内に受領確認されます。

segments.src: If you are using tax software or a preparer, confirm they can submit before the cutoff, since many offices are busy this week.
segments.tr: 税務ソフトや作成者を使用している場合は、今週は多くのオフィスが混雑しているため、締め切り前に提出できることを確認してください。

segments.src: Pay what you can.** Payment options include IRS Direct Pay from a bank account, a debit or credit card (processing fees apply), or the Electronic Federal Tax Payment System.
segments.tr: 支払える分を支払う。** 支払いオプションには、銀行口座からのIRSダイレクトペイ、デビットカードまたはクレジットカード（手数料がかかります）、または電子連邦税納税システムが含まれます。

segments.src: Paying part of the balance reduces the amount on which penalties and interest are calculated.
segments.tr: 残高の一部を支払うことで、ペナルティと利息が計算される元となる金額が減少します。

segments.src: If you cannot pay in full, ask about a payment plan.** The IRS offers short-term payment arrangements and longer-term installment agreements.
segments.tr: 全額支払えない場合は、支払いプランについて問い合わせる。** IRSは短期の支払い手配や長期の分割払いの取り決めを提供しています。

segments.src: Many individuals can apply online.
segments.tr: 多くの個人がオンラインで申請できます。

segments.src: Penalties and interest continue to accrue on an unpaid balance during a plan, but the failure-to-pay rate is generally reduced while an approved installment agreement is in effect.
segments.tr: プランの実施中も未払い残高に対してペナルティと利息が加算され続けますが、承認された分割払いが有効な間は、未納ペナルティの利率が一般的に引き下げられます。

segments.src: ## Special situations
segments.tr: ## 特殊な状況

segments.src: - **Expecting a refund?** There is generally no failure-to-file penalty when you are owed a refund. However, you usually have three years from the original due date to claim it, so it is still worth filing.
segments.tr: - **還付金を期待していますか？** 還付金が支払われるべき場合、未申告ペナルティは通常ありません。ただし、通常は元の期限から3年以内に請求する必要があるため、それでも申告する価値はあります。

segments.src: - **Living abroad?** U.S. citizens and residents living outside the country receive an automatic extension to June 15 and can request additional time, which may run to December 15.
segments.tr: - **海外在住ですか？** 国外に居住する米国の市民および居住者は、6月15日までの自動延長を受けられ、12月15日まで延長される可能性のある追加の時間をリクエストできます。

segments.src: - **Affected by a federally declared disaster?** The IRS often postpones deadlines for affected areas. Check the agency's disaster relief page to see whether your county qualifies and what your specific date is.
segments.tr: - **連邦政府が宣言した災害の影響を受けましたか？** IRSは影響を受けた地域の期限をしばしば延期します。お住まいの郡が対象となるか、具体的な日付がいつであるかを確認するために、機関の災害救援ページを確認してください。

segments.src: - **Penalty relief.** If you have a reasonable explanation for filing or paying late, or a clean compliance history, you may qualify for penalty abatement. The IRS has an administrative waiver for first-time offenders who meet certain conditions.
segments.tr: - **ペナルティの救済。** 期限遅れの申告や支払いに対する合理的な説明がある場合、またはクリーンなコンプライアンス履歴がある場合、ペナルティの減免の対象となる可能性があります。IRSには、特定の条件を満たす初犯者向けの管理上の免除があります。

segments.src: ## Common mistakes to avoid
segments.tr: ## 避けるべき一般的な間違い

segments.src: - **Assuming the extension covered payment.** It did not.
segments.tr: - **延長が支払いをカバーしていると仮定すること。** カバーしていません。

segments.src: - **Waiting for a perfect return.** Filing an accurate return on time is better than a late one with every detail polished. You can file an amended return later if needed.
segments.tr: - **完璧な申告書を待つこと。** すべての詳細を磨き上げた遅い申告書よりも、正確な申告書を期限内に提出する方が優れています。必要に応じて、後で修正申告書を提出できます。

segments.src: - **Skipping the signature or identity step.** E-filers may need a prior-year adjusted gross income figure or an identity PIN. Have these ready.
segments.tr: - **署名または本人確認のステップをスキップすること。** 電子申告者は、前年の調整後総所得の数値または本人確認用PINが必要な場合があります。これらを準備しておいてください。

segments.src: - **Ignoring IRS notices.** If you receive a letter, read it carefully and respond by the stated date.
segments.tr: - **IRSからの通知を無視すること。** 手紙を受け取った場合は、注意深く読み、記載された日付までに返答してください。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 要点

segments.src: October 15 is a firm date for extension filers.
segments.tr: 10月15日は、延長申告者にとって確実な期限です。

segments.src: Submit your return on time, pay as much as you can, and contact the IRS about a payment arrangement if you cannot cover the full amount.
segments.tr: 期限内に申告書を提出し、支払える限り支払い、全額をカバーできない場合は支払い手配についてIRSに連絡してください。

segments.src: Taking those steps will help keep penalties and interest as low as possible.
segments.tr: これらの措置を講じることで、ペナルティと利息を可能な限り低く抑えることができます。

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not tax advice.
segments.tr: *この記事は一般的な情報提供のみを目的としており、税務上の助言ではありません。

segments.src: Rules and amounts can change, and individual circumstances vary.
segments.tr: ルールや金額は変更される可能性があり、個人の状況によって異なります。

segments.src: Consult a qualified tax professional or visit IRS.gov for guidance specific to your situation.*
segments.tr: ご自身の状況に合わせたガイダンスについては、有資格の税理士に相談するか、IRS.govをご覧ください。*

segments.src: Here is a plain-language guide to who is affected, what the extension actually covers, and how to limit penalties and interest.

segments.src: ## An extension to file is not an extension to pay

segments.src: This is the most common point of confusion.

segments.tr: Sie gibt Ihnen nicht mehr Zeit, **das zu bezahlen, was Sie schulden**.

segments.src: Taxes for 2025 were due in April, and any unpaid balance has been accruing charges since then.
segments.tr: Die Steuern für 2025 waren im April fällig, und jeder unbezahlte Saldo hat seitdem Gebühren angesammelt.

segments.src: That means two separate costs may already be running on a balance due:
segments.tr: Das bedeutet, dass für einen fälligen Saldo bereits zwei separate Kosten anfallen können:

segments.src: 1. **Interest.** The IRS charges interest on unpaid tax from the original due date until the balance is paid in full. The rate is based on the federal short-term rate plus three percentage points and is reset each quarter. Interest compounds daily.
segments.tr: 1. **Zinsen.** Das IRS erhebt Zinsen auf unbezahlte Steuern ab dem ursprünglichen Fälligkeitstermin, bis der Saldo vollständig bezahlt ist. Der Zinssatz basiert auf dem federal short-term rate plus drei Prozentpunkten und wird jedes Quartal neu festgelegt. Zinsen werden täglich verzinst.

segments.src: 2. **Failure-to-pay penalty.** This is generally 0.5% of the unpaid tax for each month or partial month the balance remains unpaid, up to a maximum of 25%.
segments.tr: 2. **Verspätungszuschlag für die Zahlung.** Dieser beträgt im Allgemeinen 0,5 % der unbezahlten Steuer für jeden Monat oder Teilmonat, in dem der Saldo unbezahlt bleibt, bis zu einem Maximum von 25%.

segments.src: ## What happens if you miss October 15
segments.tr: ## Was passiert, wenn Sie den 15. Oktober verpassen

segments.src: Missing the extended deadline adds a third cost on top of the two above:
segments.tr: Das Verpassen der verlängerten Frist fügt den beiden oben genannten Kosten eine dritte hinzu:

segments.src: - **Failure-to-file penalty.** This is generally 5% of the unpaid tax for each month or partial month the return is late, up to 25%. When both the late-filing and late-payment penalties apply in the same month, the combined rate is typically 5% for that month, because the filing penalty is reduced by the payment penalty.
segments.tr: - **Verspätungszuschlag für die Einreichung.** Dieser beträgt im Allgemeinen 5 % der unbezahlten Steuer für jeden Monat oder Teilmonat, in dem die Steuererklärung verspätet ist, bis zu 25%. Wenn sowohl die Strafe für verspätete Einreichung als auch für verspätete Zahlung im selben Monat anfallen, beträgt der kombinierte Satz für diesen Monat typischerweise 5 %, da die Einreichungsstrafe um die Zahlungsstrafe reduziert wird.

segments.src: - **Minimum penalty.** If a return is more than 60 days late, a minimum penalty applies, which is the lesser of a set dollar amount (adjusted for inflation) or 100% of the tax owed.
segments.tr: - **Mindeststrafe.** Wenn eine Steuererklärung mehr als 60 Tage zu spät ist, fällt eine Mindeststrafe an, die dem niedrigeren Betrag aus einem festgelegten Dollarmetrag (angepasst an die Inflation) oder 100 % der geschuldeten Steuer entspricht.

segments.src: Because the filing penalty is ten times larger than the payment penalty each month, **filing on time matters even if you cannot pay everything you owe.**
segments.tr: Da die Einreichungsstrafe jeden Monat zehnmal so hoch ist wie die Zahlungsstrafe, **ist die fristgerechte Einreichung wichtig, selbst wenn Sie nicht alles bezahlen können, was Sie schulden.**

segments.src: ## What to do now
segments.tr: ## Was Sie jetzt tun sollten

segments.src: Gather your documents.** Collect W-2s, 1099s, brokerage statements, business records, and any corrected forms.
segments.tr: Sammeln Sie Ihre Unterlagen.** Sammeln Sie W-2-Formulare, 1099-Formulare, Maklerabrechnungen, Geschäftsunterlagen und alle korrigierten Formulare.

segments.src: If something is still missing, you can request a copy from the issuer or obtain your income transcript through your IRS online account.
segments.tr: Wenn immer noch etwas fehlt, können Sie eine Kopie beim Aussteller anfordern oder Ihren Einkommenstranskript über Ihr Online-Konto beim IRS abrufen.

segments.src: Estimate what you owe.** Even a reasonable estimate helps you decide how much to send with your return.
segments.tr: Schätzen Sie, was Sie schulden.** Selbst eine vernünftige Schätzung hilft Ihnen zu entscheiden, wie viel Sie mit Ihrer Steuererklärung senden sollten.

segments.src: Overpaying slightly is generally better than underpaying, since a refund can be issued later.
segments.tr: Eine leichte Überzahlung ist im Allgemeinen besser als eine Unterzahlung, da eine Rückerstattung später ausgestellt werden kann.

segments.src: File by the deadline.** Electronic filing is the fastest route, and e-filed returns are typically acknowledged within a day or two.
segments.tr: Reichen Sie fristgerecht ein.** Die elektronische Einreichung ist der schnellste Weg, und elektronisch eingereichte Erklärungen werden typischerweise innerhalb von ein bis zwei Tagen bestätigt.

segments.src: If you are using tax software or a preparer, confirm they can submit before the cutoff, since many offices are busy this week.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie eine Steuersoftware oder einen Steuerberater nutzen, bestätigen Sie, dass diese vor dem Stichtag einreichen können, da viele Büros diese Woche beschäftigt sind.

segments.src: Pay what you can.** Payment options include IRS Direct Pay from a bank account, a debit or credit card (processing fees apply), or the Electronic Federal Tax Payment System.
segments.tr: Zahlen Sie, was Sie können.** Zu den Zahlungsoptionen gehören IRS Direct Pay von einem Bankkonto, eine Debit- oder Kreditkarte (Bearbeitungsgebühren fallen an) oder das Electronic Federal Tax Payment System.

segments.src: Paying part of the balance reduces the amount on which penalties and interest are calculated.
segments.tr: Die Zahlung eines Teils des Saldos reduziert den Betrag, auf den Strafen und Zinsen berechnet werden.

segments.src: If you cannot pay in full, ask about a payment plan.** The IRS offers short-term payment arrangements and longer-term installment agreements.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie nicht vollständig bezahlen können, fragen Sie nach einem Zahlungsplan.** Das IRS bietet kurzfristige Zahlungsvereinbarungen und längerfristige Ratenzahlungsvereinbarungen an.

segments.src: Many individuals can apply online.
segments.tr: Viele Einzelpersonen können sich online bewerben.

segments.src: Penalties and interest continue to accrue on an unpaid balance during a plan, but the failure-to-pay rate is generally reduced while an approved installment agreement is in effect.
segments.tr: Strafen und Zinsen laufen während eines Plans auf einem unbezahlten Saldo weiter, aber der Satz für verspätete Zahlung wird im Allgemeinen reduziert, während eine genehmigte Ratenzahlungsvereinbarung in Kraft ist.

segments.src: ## Special situations
segments.tr: ## Besondere Situationen

segments.src: - **Expecting a refund?** There is generally no failure-to-file penalty when you are owed a refund. However, you usually have three years from the original due date to claim it, so it is still worth filing.
segments.tr: - **Erwarten Sie eine Rückerstattung?** Es gibt im Allgemeinen keine Strafe für verspätete Einreichung, wenn Ihnen eine Rückerstattung zusteht. Sie haben jedoch normalerweise drei Jahre ab dem ursprünglichen Fälligkeitstermin Zeit, diese einzufordern, daher lohnt sich die Einreichung dennoch.

segments.src: - **Living abroad?** U.S. citizens and residents living outside the country receive an automatic extension to June 15 and can request additional time, which may run to December 15.
segments.tr: - **Leben Sie im Ausland?** US-Bürger und -Ansässige, die außerhalb des Landes leben, erhalten eine automatische Verlängerung bis zum 15. Juni und können zusätzliche Zeit beantragen, die bis zum 15. Dezember laufen kann.

segments.src: - **Affected by a federally declared disaster?** The IRS often postpones deadlines for affected areas. Check the agency's disaster relief page to see whether your county qualifies and what your specific date is.
segments.tr: - **Von einer föderal erklärten Katastrophe betroffen?** Das IRS verschiebt häufig Fristen für betroffene Gebiete. Überprüfen Sie die Katastrophenhilfeseite der Behörde, um zu sehen, ob Ihr Landkreis qualifiziert ist und wie Ihr spezifisches Datum lautet.

segments.src: - **Penalty relief.** If you have a reasonable explanation for filing or paying late, or a clean compliance history, you may qualify for penalty abatement. The IRS has an administrative waiver for first-time offenders who meet certain conditions.
segments.tr: - **Strafenerleichterung.** Wenn Sie eine vernünftige Erklärung für die verspätete Einreichung oder Zahlung haben oder eine saubere Compliance-Historie vorweisen können, qualifizieren Sie sich möglicherweise für einen Straferlass. Das IRS hat einen administrativen Verzicht für Ersttäter, die bestimmte Bedingungen erfüllen.

segments.src: ## Common mistakes to avoid
segments.tr: ## Häufige Fehler, die es zu vermeiden gilt

segments.src: - **Assuming the extension covered payment.** It did not.
segments.tr: - **Anzunehmen, dass die Verlängerung die Zahlung abdeckte.** Das tat sie nicht.

segments.src: - **Waiting for a perfect return.** Filing an accurate return on time is better than a late one with every detail polished. You can file an amended return later if needed.
segments.tr: - **Auf eine perfekte Steuererklärung warten.** Das rechtzeitige Einreichen einer genauen Steuererklärung ist besser als eine verspätete, bei der jedes Detail poliert ist. Sie können bei Bedarf später eine geänderte Steuererklärung einreichen.

segments.src: - **Skipping the signature or identity step.** E-filers may need a prior-year adjusted gross income figure or an identity PIN. Have these ready.
segments.tr: - **Den Unterschriften- oder Identitätsschritt auslassen.** Elektronische Einreicher benötigen möglicherweise eine bereinigte Bruttoeinkommenszahl des Vorjahres oder eine Identitäts-PIN. Halten Sie diese bereit.

segments.src: - **Ignoring IRS notices.** If you receive a letter, read it carefully and respond by the stated date.
segments.tr: - **IRS-Bescheide ignorieren.** Wenn Sie einen Brief erhalten, lesen Sie ihn sorgfältig durch und antworten Sie bis zum angegebenen Datum.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Fazit

segments.src: October 15 is a firm date for extension filers.
segments.tr: Der 15. Oktober ist ein verbindliches Datum für Verlängerungseinreicher.

segments.src: Submit your return on time, pay as much as you can, and contact the IRS about a payment arrangement if you cannot cover the full amount.
segments.tr: Reichen Sie Ihre Steuererklärung fristgerecht ein, zahlen Sie so viel Sie können, und kontaktieren Sie das IRS bezüglich einer Zahlungsvereinbarung, wenn Sie den vollen Betrag nicht aufbringen können.

segments.src: Taking those steps will help keep penalties and interest as low as possible.
segments.tr: Diese Schritte tragen dazu bei, Strafen und Zinsen so gering wie möglich zu halten.

segments.tr: *Dieser Artikel dient nur zu allgemeinen Informationszwecken und stellt keine Steuerberatung dar.

segments.tr: Regeln und Beträge können sich ändern, und individuelle Umstände variieren.

segments.tr: Konsultieren Sie einen qualifizierten Steuerberater oder besuchen Sie IRS.gov für Anleitungen, die spezifisch für Ihre Situation sind.*

vi.title: Hạn chót gia hạn thuế ngày 15 tháng 10: Người nộp thuế cần làm gì trước thời điểm này

segments.src: If you requested more time to file your federal income tax return back in April, your extended deadline arrives this week: **Thursday, October 15**.
segments.tr: Nếu bạn đã yêu cầu thêm thời gian để nộp tờ khai thuế thu nhập liên bang vào tháng 4, thời hạn gia hạn của bạn sẽ đến vào tuần này: **Thứ Năm, ngày 15 tháng 10**.

segments.src: For millions of Americans, this is the last scheduled day to submit a 2025 return without running into additional late-filing consequences.
segments.tr: Đối với hàng triệu người Mỹ, đây là ngày cuối cùng theo lịch trình để nộp tờ khai 2025 mà không gặp phải các hậu quả bổ sung do nộp chậm.

segments.src: Here is a plain-language guide to who is affected, what the extension actually covers, and how to limit penalties and interest.
segments.tr: Dưới đây là hướng dẫn bằng ngôn ngữ thông thường về những ai bị ảnh hưởng, việc gia hạn thực sự bao gồm những gì, và cách hạn chế tiền phạt cũng như tiền lãi.

segments.src: ## Who is affected
segments.tr: ## Ai bị ảnh hưởng

segments.src: The October 15 date applies to taxpayers who filed Form 4868 (for individuals) or otherwise requested an automatic six-month extension by the April deadline.
segments.tr: Ngày 15 tháng 10 áp dụng cho những người nộp thuế đã nộp Mẫu 4868 (đối với cá nhân) hoặc đã yêu cầu tự động gia hạn sáu tháng trước thời hạn tháng 4.

segments.src: That group typically includes:
segments.tr: Nhóm đó thường bao gồm:

segments.src: - **Self-employed workers and freelancers** with complex income and estimated payments to reconcile
segments.tr: - **Người lao động tự do và người làm nghề tự do** có thu nhập phức tạp và các khoản thanh toán ước tính cần đối chiếu

segments.src: - **Small business owners and investors** waiting on partnership, S corporation, or brokerage documents
segments.tr: - **Chủ doanh nghiệp nhỏ và nhà đầu tư** đang chờ tài liệu công ty hợp danh, công ty S, hoặc công ty môi giới

segments.src: - **Households with several income sources**, such as rental income, stock sales, or retirement distributions
segments.tr: - **Các hộ gia đình có nhiều nguồn thu nhập**, chẳng hạn như thu nhập từ cho thuê nhà, bán cổ phiếu, hoặc phân phối hưu trí

segments.src: - **People who simply ran out of time** or were missing key forms in the spring
segments.tr: - **Những người đơn giản là hết thời gian** hoặc thiếu các biểu mẫu quan trọng vào mùa xuân

segments.src: If you did not request an extension and have not yet filed, you are already past the original due date, and late-filing and late-payment rules may already be applying to you.
segments.tr: Nếu bạn không yêu cầu gia hạn và chưa nộp thuế, bạn đã quá thời hạn ban đầu, và các quy định về nộp chậm và trả chậm có thể đã áp dụng đối với bạn.

segments.src: Filing as soon as possible is still better than waiting.
segments.tr: Nộp thuế càng sớm càng tốt vẫn tốt hơn là chờ đợi.

segments.src: ## An extension to file is not an extension to pay
segments.tr: ## Gia hạn nộp tờ khai không phải là gia hạn nộp tiền

segments.src: This is the most common point of confusion.
segments.tr: Đây là điểm nhầm lẫn phổ biến nhất.

segments.src: An extension gives you more time to **submit your paperwork**.
segments.tr: Việc gia hạn cho bạn thêm thời gian để **nộp giấy tờ**.

segments.src: It does not give you more time to **pay what you owe**.
segments.tr: Nó không cho bạn thêm thời gian để **thanh toán số tiền bạn nợ**.

segments.src: Taxes for 2025 were due in April, and any unpaid balance has been accruing charges since then.
segments.tr: Thuế năm 2025 đến hạn vào tháng 4, và bất kỳ số dư chưa thanh toán nào cũng đã tích lũy các khoản phí kể từ đó.

segments.src: That means two separate costs may already be running on a balance due:
segments.tr: Điều đó có nghĩa là hai khoản chi phí riêng biệt có thể đã phát sinh trên số dư chưa thanh toán:

segments.src: 1. **Interest.** The IRS charges interest on unpaid tax from the original due date until the balance is paid in full. The rate is based on the federal short-term rate plus three percentage points and is reset each quarter. Interest compounds daily.
segments.tr: 1. **Tiền lãi.** IRS tính tiền lãi đối với thuế chưa nộp kể từ thời hạn ban đầu cho đến khi số dư được thanh toán đầy đủ. Lãi suất dựa trên lãi suất ngắn hạn liên bang cộng với ba điểm phần trăm và được thiết lập lại mỗi quý. Tiền lãi cộng dồn hàng ngày.

segments.src: 2. **Failure-to-pay penalty.** This is generally 0.5% of the unpaid tax for each month or partial month the balance remains unpaid, up to a maximum of 25%.
segments.tr: 2. **Tiền phạt chậm nộp tiền.** Khoản này thường là 0,5% số thuế chưa nộp cho mỗi tháng hoặc phần của tháng mà số dư vẫn chưa được thanh toán, tối đa lên tới 25%.

segments.src: ## What happens if you miss October 15
segments.tr: ## Điều gì xảy ra nếu bạn bỏ lỡ ngày 15 tháng 10

segments.src: Missing the extended deadline adds a third cost on top of the two above:
segments.tr: Việc bỏ lỡ thời hạn gia hạn sẽ cộng thêm chi phí thứ ba bên cạnh hai chi phí nêu trên:

segments.src: - **Failure-to-file penalty.** This is generally 5% of the unpaid tax for each month or partial month the return is late, up to 25%. When both the late-filing and late-payment penalties apply in the same month, the combined rate is typically 5% for that month, because the filing penalty is reduced by the payment penalty.
segments.tr: - **Tiền phạt chậm nộp tờ khai.** Khoản này thường là 5% số thuế chưa nộp cho mỗi tháng hoặc phần của tháng mà tờ khai bị nộp chậm, tối đa lên tới 25%. Khi cả hai khoản phạt chậm nộp tờ khai và chậm nộp tiền đều được áp dụng trong cùng một tháng, tỷ lệ kết hợp thường là 5% cho tháng đó, vì tiền phạt nộp tờ khai được giảm trừ bởi tiền phạt nộp tiền.

segments.src: - **Minimum penalty.** If a return is more than 60 days late, a minimum penalty applies, which is the lesser of a set dollar amount (adjusted for inflation) or 100% of the tax owed.
segments.tr: - **Tiền phạt tối thiểu.** Nếu tờ khai chậm hơn 60 ngày, mức phạt tối thiểu sẽ được áp dụng, bằng mức nhỏ hơn giữa một số tiền cố định (được điều chỉnh theo lạm phát) hoặc 100% số thuế còn nợ.

segments.src: Because the filing penalty is ten times larger than the payment penalty each month, **filing on time matters even if you cannot pay everything you owe.**
segments.tr: Vì tiền phạt nộp tờ khai lớn gấp mười lần tiền phạt nộp tiền mỗi tháng, **việc nộp đúng hạn rất quan trọng ngay cả khi bạn không thể thanh toán toàn bộ số tiền bạn nợ.**

segments.src: ## What to do now
segments.tr: ## Phải làm gì bây giờ

segments.src: Gather your documents.** Collect W-2s, 1099s, brokerage statements, business records, and any corrected forms.
segments.tr: Thu thập tài liệu của bạn.** Thu thập các mẫu W-2, 1099, sao kê công ty môi giới, hồ sơ doanh nghiệp và bất kỳ biểu mẫu nào đã được sửa đổi.

segments.src: If something is still missing, you can request a copy from the issuer or obtain your income transcript through your IRS online account.
segments.tr: Nếu thiếu thứ gì đó, bạn có thể yêu cầu một bản sao từ bên phát hành hoặc lấy bản sao kê thu nhập thông qua tài khoản trực tuyến IRS của bạn.

segments.src: Estimate what you owe.** Even a reasonable estimate helps you decide how much to send with your return.
segments.tr: Ước tính số tiền bạn nợ.** Ngay cả một ước tính hợp lý cũng giúp bạn quyết định số tiền cần gửi cùng với tờ khai của mình.

segments.src: Overpaying slightly is generally better than underpaying, since a refund can be issued later.
segments.tr: Thừa một chút thường tốt hơn là thiếu một chút, vì khoản hoàn thuế có thể được phát hành sau đó.

segments.src: File by the deadline.** Electronic filing is the fastest route, and e-filed returns are typically acknowledged within a day or two.
segments.tr: Nộp trước thời hạn.** Nộp tờ khai điện tử là con đường nhanh nhất, và các tờ khai nộp điện tử thường được xác nhận trong vòng một hoặc hai ngày.

segments.src: If you are using tax software or a preparer, confirm they can submit before the cutoff, since many offices are busy this week.
segments.tr: Nếu bạn đang sử dụng phần mềm thuế hoặc người chuẩn bị thuế, hãy xác nhận họ có thể nộp trước thời hạn chót, vì nhiều văn phòng rất bận rộn trong tuần này.

segments.src: Pay what you can.** Payment options include IRS Direct Pay from a bank account, a debit or credit card (processing fees apply), or the Electronic Federal Tax Payment System.
segments.tr: Thanh toán những gì bạn có thể.** Các lựa chọn thanh toán bao gồm IRS Direct Pay từ tài khoản ngân hàng, thẻ ghi nợ hoặc thẻ tín dụng (phí xử lý được áp dụng), hoặc Hệ thống Thanh toán Thuế Liên bang Điện tử.

segments.src: Paying part of the balance reduces the amount on which penalties and interest are calculated.
segments.tr: Thanh toán một phần số dư sẽ làm giảm số tiền dùng để tính tiền phạt và tiền lãi.

segments.src: If you cannot pay in full, ask about a payment plan.** The IRS offers short-term payment arrangements and longer-term installment agreements.
segments.tr: Nếu bạn không thể thanh toán đầy đủ, hãy hỏi về kế hoạch thanh toán.** IRS cung cấp các thỏa thuận thanh toán ngắn hạn và các thỏa thuận trả góp dài hạn.

segments.src: Many individuals can apply online.
segments.tr: Nhiều cá nhân có thể đăng ký trực tuyến.

segments.src: Penalties and interest continue to accrue on an unpaid balance during a plan, but the failure-to-pay rate is generally reduced while an approved installment agreement is in effect.
segments.tr: Tiền phạt và tiền lãi tiếp tục tích lũy trên số dư chưa thanh toán trong suốt kế hoạch, nhưng tỷ lệ chậm nộp tiền thường được giảm trong khi thỏa thuận trả góp được phê duyệt có hiệu lực.

segments.src: ## Special situations
segments.tr: ## Các tình huống đặc biệt

segments.src: - **Expecting a refund?** There is generally no failure-to-file penalty when you are owed a refund. However, you usually have three years from the original due date to claim it, so it is still worth filing.
segments.tr: - **Mong đợi được hoàn thuế?** Thường không có khoản phạt chậm nộp tờ khai khi bạn được hoàn thuế. Tuy nhiên, bạn thường có ba năm kể từ thời hạn ban đầu để khiếu nại, vì vậy việc nộp thuế vẫn đáng giá.

segments.src: - **Living abroad?** U.S. citizens and residents living outside the country receive an automatic extension to June 15 and can request additional time, which may run to December 15.
segments.tr: - **Sống ở nước ngoài?** Công dân và cư dân Hoa Kỳ sống bên ngoài đất nước nhận được thời gian gia hạn tự động đến ngày 15 tháng 6 và có thể yêu cầu thêm thời gian, có thể kéo dài đến ngày 15 tháng 12.

segments.src: - **Affected by a federally declared disaster?** The IRS often postpones deadlines for affected areas. Check the agency's disaster relief page to see whether your county qualifies and what your specific date is.
segments.tr: - **Bị ảnh hưởng bởi thảm họa được liên bang công bố?** IRS thường hoãn thời hạn cho các khu vực bị ảnh hưởng. Kiểm tra trang cứu trợ thảm họa của cơ quan này để xem quận của bạn có đủ điều kiện hay không và ngày cụ thể của bạn là gì.

segments.src: - **Penalty relief.** If you have a reasonable explanation for filing or paying late, or a clean compliance history, you may qualify for penalty abatement. The IRS has an administrative waiver for first-time offenders who meet certain conditions.
segments.tr: - **Miễn giảm tiền phạt.** Nếu bạn có lời giải thích hợp lý cho việc nộp hoặc thanh toán chậm, hoặc lịch sử tuân thủ sạch sẽ, bạn có thể đủ điều kiện được giảm phạt. IRS có một miễn trừ hành chính cho những người vi phạm lần đầu đáp ứng các điều kiện nhất định.

segments.src: ## Common mistakes to avoid
segments.tr: ## Các lỗi phổ biến cần tránh

segments.src: - **Assuming the extension covered payment.** It did not.
segments.tr: - **Cho rằng việc gia hạn đã bao gồm việc thanh toán.** Không phải vậy.

segments.src: - **Waiting for a perfect return.** Filing an accurate return on time is better than a late one with every detail polished. You can file an amended return later if needed.
segments.tr: - **Chờ đợi một tờ khai hoàn hảo.** Nộp một tờ khai chính xác đúng hạn tốt hơn là một tờ khai muộn với mọi chi tiết được trau chuốt. Bạn có thể nộp tờ khai sửa đổi sau nếu cần.

segments.src: - **Skipping the signature or identity step.** E-filers may need a prior-year adjusted gross income figure or an identity PIN. Have these ready.
segments.tr: - **Bỏ qua bước chữ ký hoặc nhận dạng.** Người nộp đơn điện tử có thể cần số liệu thu nhập gộp điều chỉnh của năm trước hoặc mã PIN nhận dạng. Hãy chuẩn bị sẵn những thứ này.

segments.src: - **Ignoring IRS notices.** If you receive a letter, read it carefully and respond by the stated date.
segments.tr: - **Phớt lờ các thông báo của IRS.** Nếu bạn nhận được thư, hãy đọc kỹ và trả lời trước ngày đã nêu.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: October 15 is a firm date for extension filers.
segments.tr: Ngày 15 tháng 10 là ngày cố định đối với những người nộp đơn gia hạn.

segments.src: Submit your return on time, pay as much as you can, and contact the IRS about a payment arrangement if you cannot cover the full amount.
segments.tr: Hãy nộp tờ khai của bạn đúng hạn, thanh toán nhiều nhất có thể, và liên hệ với IRS về một thỏa thuận thanh toán nếu bạn không thể chi trả toàn bộ số tiền.

segments.src: Taking those steps will help keep penalties and interest as low as possible.
segments.tr: Thực hiện các bước đó sẽ giúp giữ cho tiền phạt và tiền lãi ở mức thấp nhất có thể.
